Over the past week, the Biden administration vetoed a UN Security Council resolution calling for a ceasefire, and bypassed Congress to send more weapons to Israel’s military as it slaughters Palestinians. President Biden and my colleagues in Congress have seen dead Palestinian children pulled from the rubble in their pajamas. They’ve seen refugee camps, UN schools, and hospitals bombed with U.S. bombs. They’re watching now as people in Gaza are dying from disease and starving, without enough food or water.
Israel’s government has already massacred over 18,000 Palestinians, and our federal government is egging on even more bloodshed.
It shouldn’t be controversial to say: Stop the killing! Let’s save lives! But rather than work for a ceasefire, rather than acknowledge the humanity of Palestinians or stop the genocide, our elected leaders are supporting more violence.

Friend,
**Yesterday, the House voted to formally open an impeachment inquiry into President Biden.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75191744/443906515/-801280688?refcode2=bd59f611-df9a-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&refcode=em231214-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDU5ZjYxMS1kZjlhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Afu_i3cQBPv_3KJL6R6PVkRd5t5lKl5Ptif9vBsOleI=)
After a year of outrageous and unjustifiable claims against President Biden and an investigation that proved absolutely no evidence of crimes, the GOP finally achieved their goal: Getting revenge for Trump. Because that’s all this inquiry is. Revenge for Trump.
This groundless and unjustifiable impeachment inquiry comes after a year-long failed search by Republicans to find incriminating evidence against President Biden.
MAGA Republicans claim that a formal inquiry is needed to continue their investigation, yet they have no reason or rationale to continue fishing for crimes after a year of finding nothing. This inquiry is a continuous waste of resources and time of elected officials.
The GOP should be expending their energy bringing impactful legislation to the floor — legislation that will help the lives of Americans — yet they continue to play games on the House floor and abuse their power as elected officials.
Plain and simple: this formal impeachment inquiry against the president is a political stunt and the GOP’s latest ploy to serve Trump.
**[If you agree that MAGA Republicans should not have the power to launch unnecessary and unjustified impeachment inquiries against the president and Democrats, please contribute $3 to my campaign today to help us take back the House majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75191766/443906525/-801280688?refcode2=bd59f611-df9a-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&refcode=em231214-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDU5ZjYxMS1kZjlhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Afu_i3cQBPv_3KJL6R6PVkRd5t5lKl5Ptif9vBsOleI=)**
Thank you for being a part of our movement for accountability. The work we are doing matters.
Robert

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

I was among the first to endorse Lori in 2022 when she first ran, and I am excited to throw my support behind her again in 2024. Lori has been a tireless advocate for the people of Oregon, working diligently to address the unique challenges facing her constituents. From championing small businesses to promoting education and healthcare initiatives, Lori has consistently demonstrated her commitment to positively impacting the lives of those she serves. As someone who understands the importance of strong, principled leadership in Congress, I believe that Lori is the right person to continue representing the people of Oregon. Her dedication to common-sense solutions and bipartisan collaboration sets her apart as a true leader in these divisive times. Now, more than ever, we need representatives like Lori Chavez-DeRemer, who are committed to putting the needs of their constituents first and working towards a better, more prosperous future for all Americans. Join me and support Lori's re-election campaign: Thank you for your continued support of principled leaders like Lori Chavez-DeRemer. Together, we can ensure that she continues to represent the values and aspirations of the people of Oregon and America. | Elise Stefanik | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

clean_body: | | | | Protect Your Children Friend, Senator Cassidy is making everyone here at HQ proud. He recently sent a letter to Facebook and DEMANDED that theystop evading the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act. Stepping up to protect our children should bypass party lines and petty politics. Will you take a moment to proudly sign your name right next to the Senators and DEMAND that Metastops intentionally evading the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act? Thank you, Cassidy Digital Team | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" | "LinkedIn" ---|---|---|--- Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility. As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act. Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. Peter, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

subject: Dr. Cornel West Achieves Alaska Ballot Access with Ambitious $10,000 UBI Initiative
body:
We are on the ballot in Alaska!

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=L0vWSOy_QdrTdUsf_jo6vHg9O7xvFPHoRyHNejdpv68&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=alaska_ballot_access&n=1)
---
### Dr. Cornel West Achieves Alaska Ballot Access with Ambitious $10,000 UBI Initiative
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **Thursday, December 14th, 2023**
Cornel West for President
[press@cornelwest2024.com](mailto:press@cornelwest2024.com) Independent candidate for president, Dr. Cornel West, backed by Alaska’s Aurora Party has obtained ballot access in Alaska for the 2024 US Presidential Election making him the first Independent candidate in the state to achieve the feat. _“We're fighting for a society where public welfare is prioritized over private profit, where our environment is protected, where poverty is abolished, and where every vote counts by implementing rank choice voting. As part of the Aurora Party nomination and party line ballot access, it's a profound honor to be the first independent candidate on Alaska's ballot for 2024. Immense gratitude to my Alaskan family for championing this cause. Alaska, you're not just on the map, you're leading the march for justice and truth.” - Dr. Cornel West_
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=10&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=alaska_ballot_access&n=2)
---
As part of the Aurora Party nomination and party line ballot access achievement, Brother West will introduce a significant plan to raise the Alaska Permanent Dividend to $10,000 per resident, as part of a larger plan to eliminate poverty within the state. _"We’re honored to be the first state in the nation to place Dr. West on the ballot. He will be a President with the moral clarity and strength to institute a new national government with working and poor people as its priority. Alaska has a robust and independent spirit, and we will win for the Independent Dr. West in November.”_ _\- Aurora Party of Alaska_ Additionally, the campaign will work closely with the Aurora Party to showcase three salient issues in Alaska : Public Ownership of Public Lands’ Natural Resources, Eradication of Poverty through an increased Alaska Permanent Dividend Fund, and Commitment to Environmental Protections and Environmental Justice. With the financial capability of the Alaska Permanent Fund and the state's demographic size, the $10,000 dividend initiative is a practical and influential move toward implementing a Universal Basic Income (UBI) in Alaska. Enhancing his commitment to the environment, Brother West calls for an immediate moratorium on all oil and gas leasing, with a focused effort on fully protecting the idyllic Arctic National Wildlife Refuge (ANWR), including the cultural resources deemed essential to the continuation of Alaska Native’s way of life. This approach is in line with the critical need for environmentally sustainable practices that consider an increasingly perilous climate crisis that’s already distributing adverse impacts statewide, and disproportionately on Alaska Native and other environmental justice communities. Specifically, Brother West will cancel the controversial and climate killing Willow project as well as proposed geoengineering projects. Highlighting his commitments to indigenous communities nationwide, Brother West's campaign focuses on obtaining Free Prior and Informed Consent from Alaska Natives before initiating any projects or initiatives on their sovereign territory. This approach will, in part, ensure that Alaska Natives play a central role in decisions affecting their territories and cultural heritage. With respect to the general election, the Cornel West campaign is confident that the implementation of Ranked-Choice Voting in Alaska's presidential elections will benefit the campaign, offering a more favorable condition for independent candidates and transcending the limitations of a two-party system, which is a benefit for increasing democracy writ large. In summing up the Aurora party endorsement and access to the ballot, Brother West noted, “Our alignment with the Aurora party’s platform is very congruent with our own Policy Pillars, a commission to study and implement Universal Basic Income, dedication to climate action, environmental justice, and respect for Indigenous sovereignty, and overall, I am confident that both of our approaches offers a new direction for political initiatives not just in Alaska but throughout the United States, I am honored and humbled to be in partnership with them and look forward to getting to work to win the State of Alaska next November.”
---
Peter - [**will you contribute $10 today to help Dr. West get on the ballot in all 50 states? Every dollars counts - let's keep this momentum going!**](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=10&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=alaska_ballot_access&n=3)

Today, the _New York Times_ ran a feature addressing what they described as "[a disappointing policing change](https://substack.com/redirect/efb77fcd-b6d2-4acd-9773-9e285c6fcfe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," exploring the slight of hand and misdirection pervading the expansion of police body cameras as a response to unrestrained and unaccountable police violence.
At the beginning of 2015, I published an article on _Truthout_ explaining why, for voices concerned about police violence, "[police body cameras are no solution](https://substack.com/redirect/ebf55c11-08e1-488c-b690-f0b0cc3e1f55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." I explored several widely overlooked issues, including the central thesis now covered by the _Times_ nearly a decade later: police wearing body cameras in no way ensures that the public will ever see the footage they record.
Body cameras in the hands of police also represent a vast opportunity for street-level surveillance by local authorities augmenting the digital omniscience of federal three-letter agencies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2658dd1-8367-4db3-b843-9a7ce1071231?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image: Electronic Frontier Foundation, [licensed](https://substack.com/redirect/70fc2cc1-57e4-4190-b55f-0eb1c7e716da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through Creative Commons
But even that is merely the tip of the iceberg.
### A bait & switch
As I explained in 2015, body cameras offer, at best, only transparency into individual incidents. But that's far from sufficient given the lack of [accountability](https://substack.com/redirect/1344fb4d-9dbb-469d-b427-17980f4c51fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for longstanding patterns and practices--which body cameras do nothing at all to expose.
Transparency is one problem enabling police violence and lack of accountability, but it is far from the only one. The unwillingness of prosecutors to seek justice when police commit crimes has been an equally entrenched problem, although recent history suggests that the small number of prosecutors who do aim to apply the law equally face many headwinds.
On the rare occasion when prosecutors do [show up](https://substack.com/redirect/1f2272e4-9703-4144-92c3-5eb5d74748d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the hard work of holding police accountable, they often confront biases among jurors favoring police that [allow](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9802b3-302b-43fb-8834-209a559b6a80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) killer cops to [escape](https://substack.com/redirect/4d92995e-fb59-4ebf-870d-19ebabb5f895?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) justice despite prosecution.
### No good deed goes unpunished
Perversely, prosecutors who champion police accountability have even become targets themselves.

Marilyn Mosby, who made national headlines in Baltimore for prosecuting the cops who killed Freddie Grey, found herself the target of a federal investigation and now [faces](https://substack.com/redirect/b1fa0349-02c1-4574-86ab-acad57cba842?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prison time for what CNN described as "making false statements after authorities said she applied for...loans to withdraw money from her retirement accounts."
In San Francisco, former prosecutor Chesa Boudin was [removed](https://substack.com/redirect/54e9ba82-2a2f-4b99-b436-41ef781e6994?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from office through a recall campaign in 2022. Other candidates across California who sought to challenge predatory prosecutors faced vicious [smears](https://substack.com/redirect/8b623f6c-6833-4d2e-bbac-2788bcf58ae3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), not unlike those [fabricated](https://substack.com/redirect/b7648d44-362a-4a7f-8ec5-946637a71e88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to insulate corrupt congressional incumbents in the face of grassroots [challenges](https://substack.com/redirect/6ebaf97f-5dc5-4ac0-bd6f-29d6ed012f45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Stepping back even further, body cameras in the hands of police also represent a vast opportunity for [street-level surveillance](https://substack.com/redirect/14a11059-a5ab-433c-a9d8-05a04870ec25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by local authorities augmenting the digital omniscience of federal three-letter agencies. Whether or not anyone ever sees the footage they capture of police misconduct, they ultimately support the policing-industrial complex by enabling criminal prosecutions or justifying uses of force relying on their footage.

### Forcing an overdue debate
Policing, and proposed policing reforms, were just some among the vast spectrum of issues ignored by journalists when I ran for Congress to challenge a leading actor in Washington routinely indulged by the press.
After [instructing](https://substack.com/redirect/0bd7ef80-4b44-4cd6-937b-0c37324aaef8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Democrats in Congress to pay lip service to the movement for black lives in 2016, former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi in 2020 showed up in Congress [kneeling](https://substack.com/redirect/ef75ac7e-e35d-4258-8ee3-aa7aa85ee8a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in kente cloth to introduce a bill named after George Floyd (whose name she [forgot](https://substack.com/redirect/bba1af0a-2be0-49ca-b787-96510852041d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the press conference introducing it) that proposed to expand police surveillance and police budgets in spite of the movement's demands.
In 2020, when I appeared on the general election ballot in November, local journalists generally ignored our race. Those who did observe it ultimately chose to publish more ad hominem [disinformation](https://substack.com/redirect/c8f0b669-8673-461a-b8f1-532ddf7bc30e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than legitimate analysis highlighting the stark contrasts between the incumbent's policy record and my competing proposals.
In the midst of the largest grassroots movement for policing reforms in U.S. history, which I aimed to [represent ](https://substack.com/redirect/72c4a405-5a48-4e23-8e02-64bf8f9c827b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in office after [supporting](https://substack.com/redirect/1f9802b3-302b-43fb-8834-209a559b6a80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it long before the murder of George Floyd in 2020, I became the only progressive candidate in 33 (now 36) years to reach the general election for that seat in Congress.
Yet with the prominent exception of Katie Halper & Matt Taibbi at _[Rolling Stone](https://substack.com/redirect/986628c8-0352-4eec-a070-096ea28f8429?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , few outlet explored my [20-point vision](https://substack.com/redirect/64aaaf74-fbea-4200-9089-4d3ea80cdae7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to transform criminal justice. And none conducted a rigorous examination of the incumbent's public track record.
The last time Pelosi appeared in public to debate an opponent was 1987. [According](https://substack.com/redirect/d37a5366-701c-4880-b9c8-cc25ff34f008?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Billboard, the #1 song that year was "Walk Like an Egyptian," by the Bangles. That was not one generation ago--but two.
In the meantime, journalists have [indulged](https://substack.com/redirect/9aa6e15f-3dcb-4106-a299-ce606579af11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) every fabrication that her office produces, from claims about her future plans to false characterizations of her ultimately conservative voting record.
Wearing kente cloth is no substitute for legal reforms that could have stopped police from killing [over a thousand](https://substack.com/redirect/93009acd-81b9-44cd-871c-7f5a675e74d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--mostly Black and Brown--Americans every year. And human interest stories about [premium ice cream](https://substack.com/redirect/919a3f96-8098-4ee0-93ed-8b492a8856d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are no substitute for the kind of journalism that empowers voters to make better choices.

In my disappointing experience, the press can be relied upon to cover policy issues neither in the abstract, nor even when they are closely implicated in historic election contests. At least the nation's newspaper of record got one thing right eventually, even if it took a decade after others first observed the object of their eventual epiphany.
Watching Washington's charlatans continue their machinations from as far away as I can get has offered me some personal solace. I hope the journalists and editors who continue to construct cults of personality supporting authoritarian oligarchs find some path to peace for themselves.

name: Katie Porter
subject: As a single mom, I’ve learned how to plan ahead
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34783%2E3422442%2E2NBXX2)
Derek, as a single mom of three, planning ahead is essential. Whether it’s meal prep or Christmas gift shopping, I (try) not to leave things to the last minute.
I bring the same energy to our campaign, whether that’s reserving our TV ad buys early or having our campaign stops around the state planned out well in advance.
**[That’s why today I’m emailing to ask if you can contribute before our December 31st end of quarter deadline.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231214-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_EOQ_20231214_V1_F&refcode2=34783_3422442_2NBXX2&akid=34783%2E3422442%2E2NBXX2)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231214-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_EOQ_20231214_V1_F&refcode2=34783_3422442_2NBXX2&akid=34783%2E3422442%2E2NBXX2)
If you can contribute today, great! If you’d like to wait until later this month, that’s great too—we’ll send many reminder emails between now and then.
Here’s why our end of quarter deadline matters: Every three months, campaigns are required to report how much money they've raised, and those reports are made public for all to see. **This fundraising report will be our final before the primary, and super PACs love to look at these final reports for any signs of weakness.** If these super PACs sense a waning or weak campaign, they’re more likely to drop millions of dollars into a race in support of the candidate with the upper hand.
We’ve been outraised each quarter of this race, so we REALLY need a strong finish to the year. Anything you can give will mean so much!
[**Yes, I can contribute before 12/31.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231214-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_EOQ_20231214_V1_F&refcode2=34783_3422442_2NBXX2&akid=34783%2E3422442%2E2NBXX2)
Thanks for being a part of Team Porter.
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAO23_2_EOQ_20231214_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=34783_3422442_2NBXX2&akid=34783%2E3422442%2E2NBXX2)**

| The lessons that my faith taught me about miracles and believing in a brighter future continue to guide me to this day.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4761%2E5257348%2Ex6_ROC)
Derek —
Over the last eight nights as I’ve celebrated Hanukkah with my wife and friends, I’ve been reflecting on my faith and what this holiday means to me.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231214_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4761%2E5257348%2Ex6_ROC)
I’ve thought about the lessons instilled in me by my parents while growing up and the sermons from rabbis over the years. The lessons that my faith taught me about miracles and believing in a brighter future — even when so much seems broken around us — continue to guide me to this day.
These principles have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, to ensure the rule of law is applied equally, **and to protect our democracy — a precious miracle that has never been in greater jeopardy.**
It is because of my faith that I have not been discouraged when Trump and his band of MAGA allies hurl attacks my way. Derek, I know that even in the face of these insults, together we can overcome these attacks and continue working toward a brighter future.
**[Derek, tomorrow night is our final mid-month fundraising deadline of the year. Peter, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

Fellow American, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

[**If you share that vision with me, Fellow American, could you watch this video I recorded for you and then commit to a donation today?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=8a848082d7f640c59f8ff5bae7033cf7&_e=uw-PD6IO84RaellPltaf66zoJel5gPj4LgxvNH0JTR8aV4rk8-Ak5e4uCZKmAdsxIYUQum4eRjhiVsodc7jHzCc6YxkbwmpQ36chfP1K5TIU6_anVelqlUA-JYW9D_MuLoOrI1T4wjvUElY-PzDUzL4ppviKig3nAHy0kUGSPkBxj_rIFfc1zrSCrYx4UIBdd8oPUiLHGpzf0ttk9bv1nwDCstFRevUh7Iu0b-Rqgh-LPK01ropYSbG1Qr2e2MDmxRK9aTVMTjS43N36r9Mel2LAdThm3b_9IKS3EIcly2fkl0qDyBVGXLPE4Vi8WUfQXdtF-JA96qLhijyxG9a66loZGBVkIuduYMxQG39tnUFvHUfi7QlX7N83y8YHN2F5PgJ3qUnXHtfYOBHI6POX7w%3D%3D)

[** WATCH NOW **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=8a848082d7f640c59f8ff5bae7033cf7&_e=uw-PD6IO84RaellPltaf66zoJel5gPj4LgxvNH0JTR8aV4rk8-Ak5e4uCZKmAdsxIYUQum4eRjhiVsodc7jHzCc6YxkbwmpQ36chfP1K5TIU6_anVelqlUA-JYW9D_MuLoOrI1T4wjvUElY-PzDUzL4ppviKig3nAHy0kUGSPkBxj_rIFfc1zrSCrYx4UIBdd8oPUiLHGpzf0ttk9bv1nwDCstFRevUh7Iu0b-Rqgh-LPK01ropYSbG1Qr2e2MDm6xNt_IzoU_zmQ_kCJKcuuFnaVBHJFQBW-nGDDl4GRiGAjoW4hD9X8Ph4_YQ8KhgW3eksz8ioqIrZyPDhhl2lqvMMdPsVT44JVmr5d7VvdBd4-aDP1KErNW9ADe_f9sxWoCTt-iHhjOHNrmtIelEtnw%3D%3D)
I sincerely appreciate your time, effort, and support as I navigate this new role.

**_Let’s win together._**

Gratefully,

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

Police Officer

We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price.

Best of all, it's portable.
---|---
| **Thomas B.** Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning.

This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it.
---|---

Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip!
---|---
| **Chris S.** Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most!
---|---
| **Richard B.** Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks!
---|---
| **Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product.
---|---

subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5fadqb7od1gibhgu6malqf6u9fvt8oi4kotqteo_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdj62pb5c9h2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjs97eridvmsh1sq121fho94jfcvciogfvuk8lf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdj62pb5c9h2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.

I can charge my cell phone and iPad at the same time, run an electric razor, my radio, an electric blanket and so much more. It's so easy to take with you anywhere - very light!"_ _Craig W.
Police Officer
_ [**➡ YES! I Want to Protect My Family Today With Life-Saving Solar Power!**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37813%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3VRiNetNetzzzvZk%2fRgC%2fQ&sysid=1) **More Raving Reviews From Customers** | | **Rita L.** This product is so versatile, and at only 8 lbs, my grandchildren can get it. We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price.
---|---
| **Steve G.** Peace of mind for years. I purchased this product to provide power to run a box fan in the summer and lights in the winter. I can use this product every day for over four years as it can be recharged up to 2,000 times. It won't make noise that draws attention and can create comfort in a difficult situation. Best of all, it's portable.
---|---
| **Thomas B.** Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning.
---|---
| **Jana H.** Portable power was a blessing when the grid failed us. I didn't think I'd need this but I needed it shortly after receiving it. This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it.
---|---
| **Allan D.** Patriot Power Sidekick to the rescue. We brought our new Patriot Power Sidekick with us on our last camping trip and it was a blessing. Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip!
---|---
| **Chris S.** Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most!
---|---
| **Richard B.** Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks!
---|---
| **Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product.
---|---

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv1hbgd6a68p4sosp1jnopmvv40qtc1thsibjcdg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdj61p36chh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsdoihch87okodm079riiks7f7bkgnsmo4vihfj8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdj61p36chh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---

David Horowitz

But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2ekekq2hfvtcb7hdgtbp64ds7ighinsbng5p0jg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdj61p36chh2bs)**

name: Your America
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37829%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=H2u5NCuGlik8FyppaH5arA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37820%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8XbY2tjB3vITl%2bC4out5tg&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today’s ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37820%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8XbY2tjB3vITl%2bC4out5tg&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America News

On January 6, 2021, I recorded the events at the Capitol building in Washington, D.C. for a local news station back home in Florida.

**And frankly, I was scared my family would get hurt!**

I was forcefully handcuffed, then moved to the FBI building.

My wife asked for the search warrant several times, but didn’t get it until after the FBI agents finished searching our home.

**As a U.S. Marine, I survived rocket attacks and exploding roadside bombs trying to bring freedom to the people of Iraq and Afghanistan. But then my freedom gets trampled on right here at home by FBI agents!**

Can you imagine being treated like this in America?

I sure couldn’t ... but then it got worse.

Larry is founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

He’s a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 41 years.

You’ve seen him on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**Larry took on Bill Clinton, and is the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President committed a crime.**

Larry knows what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.

**And with this critically important case, Larry can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

The shocking, un-American conduct alleged in my lawsuit can’t be allowed to go on.

**If the FBI can illegally arrest me, an innocent U.S. Marine ... and if the DOJ can throw me in prison unjustly for 8 months ... they can do it to you, our families, **

**our friends, and our fellow Americans.**

That’s why I beg you to stand with me at this crucial time.

We simply can’t win this case without your urgent help. This lawsuit is very, very expensive.

Please give what you can right away!

Jesus Rivera

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z378pl22aia9g6k0g4cc87n77dcn7e0bnkvm2130_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm8or1c1h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvk7k43c757lufvb5jeu30qgklv91lpk9q12dec0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm8or1c1h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zapmd82nvkpkvs9g7jrrh07hs7oe5av5a8lk4ru0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm8or1c1h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I’ve had it. . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m sending a **_LOUD-AND-CLEAR_** message that no pro-abortion politician in the country is going to miss. . .

_Especially Nebraska State Senator Merv Riepe (R-12)._

If you haven’t heard what this traitor Republican did to earn the distain of pro-lifers, just look at this billboard we’ve put up in one if the busiest parts of the Cornhusker State:
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-y/) In 2022, Senator Riepe ran on a pro-life platform – _as all fake Republicans do since it’s a** _WINNING_** issue_ – but then he decided to stab pro-life voters in the back at the very moment when his vote mattered most!

In fact, Senator Riepe singlehandedly **_KILLED_** the six-week _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ in Nebraska by refraining to vote – _and his inaction has cost countless little preborn boys and girls their lives._

Not only that, but, by waving the white flag on abortion, Senator Riepe rolled out the red carpet for the Abortion Lobby to start pushing for an abortion referendum like the one that passed in Ohio!

Whenever the Abortion Lobby smells blood in the water – _just like they do now after Senator Riepe’s cowardice_ – Planned Parenthood’s sharks start circling.

**[So, could you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $75, or even $50 to _Students for Life Action_ right away so we can hold pro-abortion Republicans like Senator Merv Riepe accountable and prepare for the fights we’ll face in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, your action and support DOES MATTER and it DOES SAVE LIVES.

In fact, thanks to your support, pro-lifers just won yet another victory in New Hampshire where – _after our pressure_ – we stopped Planned Parenthood and two other pro-abortion organizations from receiving ANY taxpayer funds!

This is an enormous victory that has pro-abortion radicals INCENSED.

If only Nebraska Senator Riepe had the backbone of some of those Northeasterners, we’d be in far better shape in Nebraska!

That’s why we are continuing to call for his resignation and looking at all strategies for getting the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ across the finish line this session.

But since his term isn’t up until 2027, he thinks he can just wait it out and we’ll forget what he did by the time his seat is up for re-election.

Sorry Merv, that’s **_NOT_** happening!

_We’re in this for the long haul!_

But if we’re going to take him and any other weak-kneed Republicans who follow in his treacherous footsteps down, we’ll need an influx of resources.

**[Even a generous gift of $25 or $10 is critical to our efforts to do just that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-i/)!**

You see Pro-Life Friend, we have a framework in place to make Sen. Riepe’s tenure a nightmare, which includes:

**>>> _Renting billboard space in one of the busiest areas in Nebraska_.**

Anyone driving through southwest Omaha is going to see our message and since there’s nothing that a politician hates more than bad PR, this will be sure to cause some blowback for Senator Riepe.

**>>> _Sending door knockers directly to his district_.**

We have dedicated student leaders and staffers who will be putting in long hours knocking on doors, walking around all day, having conversations with voters, and sometimes facing harsh words, threats, or even violence. They’ll inform voters of Sen. Riepe’s actions and undoubtedly get many of them to vote him out!

**>>> _Literature Drops (Lit Drops) across his district_.**

Any door that isn’t answered will get a "Lit Drop" giving voters all the information they’ll need to make an educated vote. These are an incredibly effective way to mobilize voters and will leave no stone unturned when door-knocking.
With all of this in play, Senator Riepe can all but kiss his cushy office in Lincoln, Nebraska goodbye, because pro-lifers won’t rest until he is **_GONE_!**

But I can only be certain of our victory if I have the resourses to make it happen.

As I mentioned before, all of this will only be possible if I can count on your support.

To make sure we send a clear message to Senator Merv Riepe and other pro-abortion politicians showing what happens when they cross pro-lifers, **[could you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $75, or $50 to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-d/)?**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-h/) Pro-Life Friend, we need to show these crooked politicians we mean business.

And we need to show them they can’t get away with lying to our faces to get votes and then stabbing us in the back.

**[So, if you could, even a generous gift of $25 or $10 will go a long way in this fight to stop the Abortion Lobby in Nebraska and across the country](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-k/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – I’m sending a **_LOUD-AND-CLEAR_** message that no pro-abortion politician in the country is going to miss. . .

_Especially Nebraska State Senator Merv Riepe (R-12)_ – who singlehandedly **KILLED** the six-week _Heartbeat Abortion prevention Act_ from passing by refraining to vote.

With Nebraska being a **_CORE_** fight in 2024, we can’t waste any time making sure we have every resource at our disposal to counter the now-emboldened Abortion Lobby there.

**[So, if you could, a generous gift of $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to _Students for Life Action_ it will go a long way in this fight to stop the Abortion Lobby in Nebraska](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-siljlit-duchtdja-u/)!**

subject: Do you share in my vision?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
You may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day, I’m still just a dad from Louisiana.

| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687871%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M8IBt1GDPgJCjEQWxHKn4g&sysid=1) | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687871%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M8IBt1GDPgJCjEQWxHKn4g&sysid=1)
[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687872%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FpkjNA2PB5n1REszuqps4g&sysid=1)

Fellow American, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

[**If you share that vision with me, Fellow American, could you watch this video I recorded for you and then commit to a donation today?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687873%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YBrDLeiFOga4pYFobiujfQ&sysid=1)

[** WATCH NOW **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687874%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vX%2bUd2ZJYM7mE9L01JmNxQ&sysid=1)
I sincerely appreciate your time, effort, and support as I navigate this new role.

**_Let’s win together._**

Gratefully,

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

* * *

[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687885%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ypA6Tr2Uww%2bn1fu51d8YVw&sysid=1)
As Speaker, I want to hear from you on the top issues of the day. It's important for us to deliver results for the American people.

Would you take a moment to complete my [**_Official Speaker Survey_**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687886%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9wzxNUTwKlHHEPNpfTzMCA&sysid=1) today?

Your input is important to making sure we move America forward. I appreciate you taking the time to send me your input.

| **_SPEAKER MIKE JOHNSON_**
* * *
Speaker Johnson is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana.

[**WILL YOU STAND WITH SPEAKER JOHNSON?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c687887%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mjCCc9tNubvOxerIeD5lkA&sysid=1)

name: American Defense News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zntuoa18thhh08g4trnkvdd79qcs4ehqdimtekn8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj6c5h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6lhmolo9ks49414dhcav6g1f3rh3jk74n7vmsso_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj6c5h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6vpaggkii8sq932kp7a2726l27ppnm3hf5pl710_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj6c5h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| American Defense News

subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3m5uee6fko51e3ruj95tuv21mug9m4j1s6cn78o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj1cdh2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z64i9goqb00tn18p035qp1dg169n0i6s1kiharc0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj1cdh2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5q81j3bna1robfudkl4fmeffhfuvt91uhemjttg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgmaoj1cdh2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpg191elrk56evqv2stujfr4ig4sarl713o3mrag_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm1o77clh2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zufo1r0nh1ojq51u3c0s7h0vlptp3l83captm25g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm1o77clh2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
