This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zno5c6b3inp4u34cmo2bntl42ainbu2bnk2bpacg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm1o72cth2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjr0m1iggbf9baieujl8jb15pkphmp6k54m8gkl8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cdgm1o72cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. Hey Peter, can I get minute of your time today for something important?
| | | | |

| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0898f96b-ba4e-4366-a06f-59aa82195c8f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a867faa-41a7-4b89-92bc-c497e2979f6c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/T14765533-a9c6-4266-abf6-df8de0b6b78c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdf57e379-a1a8-43be-83e5-8a54c7fc91bf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

## Congress Passes Record Defense Bill
The House and Senate approved a record-high [$886 billion defense policy bill](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAURL8Gd1hwATsuKLZxl223tMBcO3dFwAISK3__5NSvPSONzsy_-3J3FCntf90Tbdvy4tZGb1wkcGk4qEV3wW6IgKpDK0cBg560GLqHFXJyAZSf0MjJeYQRtFfKrR6Dn_TUkQUBSoI0UhgDsgcHq8GgjdikG8aBaYGBWi79_0ypPXCLn_zG0q_52UX7aO2oTP1hMDOYz_PsC74alnrlF8klBgbzqzKY15z2grXyw9WKld9uA_cUI-XEA26YKvIjR1o_X8w9BUy80p44pZZ5dCe_dPm1XDOYu2LDcV4NdRiZFvvTUfyatd-P-gkAAP__c15p5A), up 3% from last year. It includes a 5.2% pay raise for troops, the biggest pay boost in decades. The bill passed in the Senate 87-13 and the House 310-118, despite concerns from some GOP members that the bill keeps intact Pentagon "social-engineering" policies, such as abortion access. Rep. | | You’ve seen the images on the news – _**Hurricanes tearing through communities,**_ leveling homes, schools, businesses. _**Floods and sea level rise swallowing coasts,**_ forcing people to move inland. _**Wildfires turning entire towns into ash**_ as thousands evacuate, their homes burning. **Climate change is a significant contributor to global displacement.** As we fight the climate crisis, we also need to help affected people find safety – and that’s why I need your help, Friend. The Climate Displaced Persons Act would lead to a more equitable immigration pathway to the U.S. for people displaced by climate change and support people affected by climate disasters around the world. [_**Please, Friend, tell Congress to pass the Climate Displaced Persons Act and offer refuge for people whose lives have been destroyed by climate change! We need 518 more signatures from your area by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2199349?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2199350?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Put yourself in the shoes of someone displaced by climate change. **You may _NEVER_ be able to go home again** – where will you go next? Wouldn’t you want someone to welcome you with open arms, recognizing the hurt and the pain you’ve experienced?
Many countries in the Global South are among the lowest contributors to climate change – but the _most impacted._ The U.S. is the **largest historical emitter of greenhouse gases,** meaning we bear more responsibility than any other country for the climate crisis and the way it affects people today. We have a responsibility to offer refuge to people displaced by climate change. The Climate Displaced Persons Act will do just that. [_**Send your message to Congress now and help people displaced by the climate crisis!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2199351?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

That's because today, the deep state controls D.C.

**Regardless of who is in office, career bureaucrats in our federal agencies like the Justice Department, Environmental Protection Agency, and the State Department independently push their own leftist agendas.

** In order to implement common-sense, conservative policies, we must have a plan to rein in these agencies and replace these leftist bureaucrats with principled conservatives.

The Heritage Foundation has that plan--called Project 2025.

**Through Project 2025, The Heritage Foundation has united 80 conservative organizations and is leading the charge for the next presidential transition plan.**

Heritage's policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we're identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

**The radical leftist mainstream media has published several panicked articles attacking Heritage and Project 2025.**

But as we like to say, if the leftist media is angry at you, you're over the target.

As 2024 rapidly approaches, we're kicking Project 2025 into high gear.

Will you help us make this much needed program a massive success? Will you support Project 2025 with a special gift today?

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5c5527763afb47ef9fac6600f2431caf&_e=18Qi-ymPSaGlNP-ZnuTpiswpiBdGJ8ORBEoaKwTTCCz-T9n5XMc_jxIFyrksGDm6rivPSmfe5pJZf2DY3t345LStFK_q_z-c-n1Sjg7eeSAgGXdqJSWPib4sRu0Lu4oF_FGmjJa-ZnrSlNnzdOX3pUeMBxK0TWGcbueJLfMhDGo3B8isQnBsdoU4rlrm4bYdZSyayv1W3l8_-FUumzOU_KH3NHAtQtV2sEH1RPm5L1mWRSOJ7mwBylCTK9qkZaRB7nnHL0WFRC-rYXB7o_0kEdOcZ8hizC6YaImtWmpapb2xAO_paasKeqhSrH8gwR1-_BBUkpVkvGktc-9310SE6Z9w2Zv8VPpVQMZLqDx9Fhp8oNYekUSA-mwG90tezVRhXeyWg9sIphyaT7s-OZdRDA%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75afca87a3f04ee6a5a59228495e8ad9&_e=HNdOcEkpxXvl-J7RMtNhMlDwuBmQ7z1gEGehX5ASQFuk8Bn2MpNsZm5xR2yZckG5FV3TXsJ6N2qv3T4LBMmNseBD4-_Dju7gdgpZfzuxs0jZDJ2hSDGNh_hTXiNAfToV8LjlfZC1xtFDwhCo20ymLAlGMOSEfBLJUzjcKqeW_t0xA63z48lslxWPHn6Too5hw5q9nkahonSEyePftR332eM7S-iQxCM4OM7kswtO8iwTJAiHqtrNf-vGKIcV6kOVhZVM_JFV-XnPHTU9oNh3WCTNZpS57qbGjcPLQS4yhvmEXJxf27Gb-gyDdQHDIT-9pvZa-c_q0uPSh8VEQIJ1UwufOb51UYD8fmW9Lcat39dbowqkD9NtGQ4ysGGFvGEVH_QtBklm39fpok09MYM-Dw%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75afca87a3f04ee6a5a59228495e8ad9&_e=HNdOcEkpxXvl-J7RMtNhMlDwuBmQ7z1gEGehX5ASQFuk8Bn2MpNsZm5xR2yZckG5FV3TXsJ6N2qv3T4LBMmNseBD4-_Dju7gdgpZfzuxs0jZDJ2hSDGNh_hTXiNAfToV8LjlfZC1xtFDwhCo20ymLAlGMOSEfBLJUzjcKqeW_t0xA63z48lslxWPHn6Too5hw5q9nkahonSEyePftR332eM7S-iQxCM4OM7kswtO8iy-kOmZsYaeCZGZ2P67degzzcEtLSpZy2k9WvJRq6UzLeLZ-0VG9ArJKEGkPJqU6J2X_NuNG7dIjwc-yZ0f5pxOB4LFy-tCayr2Y58wn6bt6oixyV3CXA5Us7JIWA5Y2XDeCy7vQXnL6w7HkEHZf2Na8d9oaZ7L1JgQitrWnljG-A%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75afca87a3f04ee6a5a59228495e8ad9&_e=HNdOcEkpxXvl-J7RMtNhMlDwuBmQ7z1gEGehX5ASQFuk8Bn2MpNsZm5xR2yZckG5FV3TXsJ6N2qv3T4LBMmNseBD4-_Dju7gdgpZfzuxs0jZDJ2hSDGNh_hTXiNAfToV8LjlfZC1xtFDwhCo20ymLAlGMOSEfBLJUzjcKqeW_t0xA63z48lslxWPHn6Too5hw5q9nkahonSEyePftR332eM7S-iQxCM4OM7kswtO8ixOk-IFPxzvbUMj3zJ2rWSb3ECfm-8SIA0e6BN_JTu1mB13DcFeL6g_kQ8HXHBJ7U5qWIe-jZF0KGd_b8iLNykGcz68vfB6qZ8Cvo0t58_HmK787TahdV4Gfrp2UlwLlA_hs8Q57YQui4KpEtbUCGLufYBXolORtfPmcIbaoAPMTw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.

| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WCTrE84jnDUNq-BzlSAKKg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnXuHQP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9wdHYub3JnL2RvbmF0ZS8yMDI0LXBhdGh3YXktdG8tdmljdG9yeS1kYWlseS1kZXZvdGlvbmFsLz91dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWVveSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1QQS1VQ04tMjAyMzEyMTVXA3NwY0IKZXO3PHxlYH0i8VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Heritage's policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we're identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

**The radical leftist mainstream media has published several panicked articles attacking Heritage and Project 2025.**

At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3b4e07222564c0e81881f363a06d1b3&_e=nVV0Ziz1XqJGs3d1c4CZcNKa9tskYd7F7CO62sLuf4GJlEdY1w7by9JNXGJFO4inSlGQugcabAJQVXC8r7t3IAwyLQNgftXq7BBWZtieTa36i5wg1NSjvB0zJ7yzvTRwZVflvbgRSwjmX4stoEgr7s0IfbzvNvDp4m31FFx651SiLMeSs_E__U8g0mCF0beL30sUtIzR-wwgaOpERgwYFx4OiISEf73hZALDSFKMHZrDblfh_8rdrFLrxGG5O4hXVQVGC-XMAXn4rwO0nQzL5gFbhSsJyMuueEeclz6W7P_2ofVLFOcag9j8AeWZjTXyOSL4gQQoGBtW4HtFl3S4DQREE1uKoM79fkJLA5fAidpMnrDSaaxiXoWEqF7XicthXY4yzSqfULHb7bdp4sWZvw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3b4e07222564c0e81881f363a06d1b3&_e=nVV0Ziz1XqJGs3d1c4CZcNKa9tskYd7F7CO62sLuf4GJlEdY1w7by9JNXGJFO4inSlGQugcabAJQVXC8r7t3IAwyLQNgftXq7BBWZtieTa36i5wg1NSjvB0zJ7yzvTRwZVflvbgRSwjmX4stoEgr7s0IfbzvNvDp4m31FFx651SiLMeSs_E__U8g0mCF0beL30sUtIzR-wwgaOpERgwYFx4OiISEf73hZALDSFKMHZpRJXu6WNjAkTcE6v8fSH2vCrYYslH3g-AvfYox5Mda5U8LMBSMF0boAbTk9GQytIyKFN8HI-vEpwQjgpfzaoHl0uCL2owLNR4CjjSBMVoLq5CgPutpIXANJ783bolp-eacle77UR2VwhrDfQ2TyCIqXjfh_O9QT9Q8hBKxcLAWLQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I shot that video on my smart phone and a digital camera to provide for my wife and kids.

I didn't attack police or even protest.

Let me tell you, I felt shocked and confused.

**And frankly, I was scared my family would get hurt!**

I was forcefully handcuffed, then moved to the FBI building.

My wife asked for the search warrant several times, but didn't get it until after the FBI agents finished searching our home.

**As a U.S. Marine, I survived rocket attacks and exploding roadside bombs trying to bring freedom to the people of Iraq and Afghanistan. But then my freedom gets trampled on right here at home by FBI agents!**

Can you imagine being treated like this in America?

My lawyer, Larry Klayman, filed this crucial lawsuit.

Larry is founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

You've seen him on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**Larry took on Bill Clinton, and is the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President committed a crime.**

Larry knows what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.

**And with this critically important case, Larry can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

With your continued support, we've kept the pressure on Scott Perry, and all of that hard work is paying off.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=915%2E135344%2EbbCHJR)

Hey there,
There’s something extra special about Michigan during the holidays – and Hollywood seems to heartedly agree! Did you know that Michigan is the location for a surprising number of Christmas movies? As you’re putting together your holiday movie list, here are a few additions since you’ll certainly recognize some of our beautiful small towns on the screen:
1. “Christmas at the Holly Hotel” follows a woman whose parents, the owners of a historic hotel in Holly, Michigan, ask her to come home from New York City for Christmas.

2. “Cupid’s Christmas,” also filmed in Holly, stars real-life Police Chief Jerry Narsh in the role of the police chief, with the fictional town raising money to save the historic train depot, just like the real town of Holly.

3. “Miracle on Christmas” was filmed entirely in Brighton, and follows a small-town family and their struggles to come together for the holidays.

4. Also shot in Brighton: “A Christmas Winter Song,” which features singer Ashanti playing a Christmas shop owner who helps a former jazz singer reconnect with his family.

5. “Small Town Santa” starring Dean Cain is a classic home-invasion gone wrong Christmas story that was filmed and set in Rockford, Michigan.

6. “A Dog for Christmas” starring Dean Cain and Richard Karn, was also filmed in Rockford, MI and the majority of the cast and crew are Michigan natives.

Some honorable mentions include: “Polar Express” – the author of the book, Chris Van Allsburg, was born and raised in Grand Rapids, “Santa Clause I, II, and III” – Tim Allen, who stars as Santa, was raised in Southeast Michigan and attended Western Michigan University, and the newest Chevy commercial which, if you haven’t seen, is a real tear jerker, and again filmed in Holly: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xnZGEUA4oBk](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1791?t=2&akid=915%2E135344%2EbbCHJR)
As you make your holiday plans, consider cozying up with a locally-shot movie and see if you can spot your favorite hangouts. You can check them out on most streaming services.
[**And as we’re getting in the holiday spirit and looking towards the end of the year, I would love your help ahead of the important FEC fundraising deadline this month. If you’re in the giving spirit, please consider helping us reach our very real fundraising goal.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231215-1-tt&t=3&akid=915%2E135344%2EbbCHJR)**

body:
Peter - a new No Doubt About It Podcast Episode | | | | | |
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=4b39b3007e&e=567664f14c)

We hope this email finds you well. We're reaching out with a special invitation to dive into the latest episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti, and this one is not to be missed!

**→**[**STREAM NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0d4e7edd97&e=567664f14c)**
**
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=529c68bbee&e=567664f14c)
In this immersive episode, we had the privilege of sitting down with Alex Marentes, the man behind the Borderland Beat website. A former Albuquerque police officer, Alex has become a dedicated crusader against the cartel violence, providing unparalleled insights into the Mexican cartel drug wars and their far-reaching impact on the United States.
| [STREAM EPISODE 60 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d1c1dc4273&e=567664f14c)
---
Alex's journey, from growing up in Juarez to serving in the Marines and dedicating three decades to the Albuquerque Police Department, has uniquely shaped his understanding of the cartels' influence. In our conversation, we shine a light on the brutal violence the cartels are infamous for and delve into the shocking depths of corruption within law enforcement that often goes unnoticed.
| [STREAM EPISODE 60 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=af54cd2c51&e=567664f14c)
---
The conversation takes us through terrifying stories that expose the power and reach of the cartels, revealing their control over drug distribution and their coordination of trafficking across borders.

Our journey concludes with an examination of strategies proposed by presidential candidates to combat Mexican cartels and discussions on potential solutions to this dire issue. We explore the vast network that fuels cartel operations and the devastating impact on both Mexico and the United States. This conversation underscores the need for strong leadership and addressing the source of the drugs.
→ [**STREAM NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=25013ff86b&e=567664f14c)
|

body:
Jeff Van Drew is Against Clean Energy | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/carolynrushforcongress/problem-solving-9427596?e=420896fe25)
---
,
The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) has [**joined 14 other federal entities in a climate change research alliance**](https://carolynrushforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866b1e87ca5aa4116782b6220&id=ca6a7ec70b&e=420896fe25)**.**
This move will help ensure that the needs of low-income households, people of color, and other vulnerable communities are considered and addressed in federal research related to climate change. **These communities are the most severely impacted by extreme weather and natural disaster and the least able to fully recover - so this is great news.**
[](https://carolynrushforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866b1e87ca5aa4116782b6220&id=fcf1847f3e&e=420896fe25)
| [CHIP IN TO SUPPORT A CANDIDATE WHO WILL FIGHT FOR CLIMATE CHANGE SOLUTIONS FOR ALL](https://carolynrushforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866b1e87ca5aa4116782b6220&id=9a26c632f0&e=420896fe25)
---
**My name is Carolyn Rush, and I am Democratic mother of five who has spent over 3 decades working as an engineer.** I’m running to represent New Jersey’s Second Congressional District in the United States House of Representatives.
My district is currently represented by a party-changing Republican who has fought against the Green New Deal and alternative energy sources like wind and solar, resulting in a score of just 5% on his [**2022 National Environmental Scorecard**](https://carolynrushforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866b1e87ca5aa4116782b6220&id=e4e665cc3f&e=420896fe25) from the League of Conservation Voters.
**In fact, since he was elected, Jeff van Drew’s score has gotten worse each year, showing backwards thinking - not progress!** Just this week, he voted YES on H.R. 4468: Choice in Automobile Retail Sales Act of 2023. This bill, if passed, will prohibit the ability of the EPA to finalize, implement, and enforce a proposed rule with respect to emissions from vehicles.

**Van Drew has sworn allegiance to Donald Trump over the needs of the people he represents and our country overall.** He’s fine with not exploring sustainable energy sources and maintaining our reliance on environment-destroying fossil fuels - but I’m not!
**I believe we need to explore all avenues for combating climate change** \- including the Green New Deal and other investments in sustainable sources of energy - and applaud our federal agencies for their commitment to finding solutions via research.
| [SUPPORT A CANDIDATE READY TO SOLVE CLIMATE CHANGE](https://carolynrushforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866b1e87ca5aa4116782b6220&id=eb5da648cb&e=420896fe25)
---
Jeff Van Drew shows no concern for our planet. We need a Representative who will advocate for clean energy and not the fossil fuel industry.**I will be your Climate Activist in Congress.**
With hope for America,
Carolyn Rush

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Internship Applications are Open for Spring and Summer of 2024!_**
---
Friends, We are looking for impressive, young Republicans to join us for the Spring and Summer of 2024! If you know anyone that would be a good fit, please send them our way! To learn more about our internship opportunities, click [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/b7a0ba5e4ffb007ac3d6b838967d376c/40313). We are building the Republican Party with great, young talent. The Indiana Republican Party internship program has produced strong leaders who have gone on to have successful careers in politics, state government, and the private sector. Many successful leaders in Indiana started **RIGHT HERE** with the Indiana GOP! Our interns will have the opportunity to create real change while learning how to run campaigns and support county parties. Next year is an important election year, we need the best and brightest to help us push Republican candidates across the finish line come November of 2024. It starts NOW. Share this [LINK](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/cc2b93a065a2c59ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) to our internship application with a college student that you think has what it takes. Help us build a strong Republican Party!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# _Gov. Holcomb Spoke at the 28th Annual Governor's Luncheon for Scouting!_
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/ac8d0f887213c0eec3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** , [attended](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/8bf14dc046f9ce44c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and was the keynote speaker for the 28th annual Governor's Luncheon for Scouting. **Gov. Holcomb** [discussed](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/499784c530e0aa18c3d6b838967d376c/40313) leadership and the importance of life-long learning that the Boy Scouts of America provides. This event is the [biggest](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/0757709038c0769ec3d6b838967d376c/40313) fundraiser of the year for local Boy Scouts chapters, with over 1,700 businesses and civic leaders in attendance raising nearly $17,000. **What he’s saying** : "Fantastic turnout at [#GovLunch2023](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/9fdd7fcc018861d13947229f28c3afba/592f4a87846e74a3c3d6b838967d376c/40313)! Inspired by the generosity of our state, supporting scouting. **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
December 15, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com?subject=null&body=null)
**Super PAC Supporting Chris Christie Places $3.5 Million Ad Buy**
_“This ad starts the 30 Day march to January 23”_
**ARLINGTON, VA —** With the New Hampshire primary less than six weeks away, and on the heels of a [winning debate performance](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a4cc39832d&e=d0a9afa930), Tell It Like It Is PAC launched its largest paid media campaign of the cycle in New Hampshire: $3.5 million dollars across broadcast, cable, statewide digital and radio.
Entitled “Unacceptable,” the :30 second spot will begin airing today, and is available here: [https://youtu.be/u6jm5z47Vu8](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=2fb321f1a3&e=d0a9afa930)
The spot focuses on not only core policy issues important to New Hampshire voters (inflation and immigration), but also reminds voters of the bold distinction between Governor Christie and the other candidates in the race: the willingness to tell the truth about former President Donald Trump.
“Folks like these three guys on the stage make it seem like his conduct is acceptable – let me make it clear, his conduct is unacceptable, he's unfit,” says Christie in the ad.
“‘Unacceptable’ is designed as the first of a series of ads appealing to New Hampshire’s unique position to reset the course of the nomination process,” stated Bill Palatucci, chairman of Tell It Like It Is PAC. “This ad starts the 30 Day march to January 23 when Granite State voters have the opportunity to send a message to their fellow Republicans that Chris Christie is the truth teller America deserves.”
The ad follows a new [Trafalgar Poll](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=7727d4cdca&e=d0a9afa930) showing Governor Christie at 14 percent, just four points behind Ambassador Nikki Haley, who has benefitted from [tens of millions of dollars](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=f8457c280a&e=d0a9afa930) of spending in recent weeks. On Wednesday, Christie held a town hall meeting before a, “[jam-packed](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=4cd946a2e1&e=d0a9afa930)” American Legion post in Londonderry.
**“Unacceptable”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=14bb33b29c&e=d0a9afa930)
**TRANSCRIPT FOR “UNACCEPTABLE” (TV:30)**
**VO:**_New Hampshire it’s up to you - to select a candidate who will secure the border._
_Get inflation under control._
_And, who tells the Truth._
**Chris Christie:**_Folks like these three guys on the stage make it seem like his conduct is acceptable – let me make it clear, his conduct is unacceptable, he's unfit._
**VO:** _Chris Christie. The only Republican with the courage to tell the truth and the experience to get it done._
_Tell It Like It Is Pac is responsible for the content of this advertisement._

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---

I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---

Some political pundits have written articles that spell doom for Republican candidates, opining that conservative candidates/causes have inundated you with too many texts and too much email to sift through in a day. While It’s true that nearly every congressional campaign in the 2024 cycle will attempt to utilize online fundraising to propel them into the House/Senate, not every email or text is created equal; and **not every email or text will deliver the entirety of your donation to the candidate you think you’re donating to.**

Bad actors and political grifters have figured out that online fundraising is a good way to make a quick buck off your generosity. **Not me. Not now, not ever.**

I know a couple of things to be true:
* We must do everything within our power to hold onto the U.S. House – the future of our country absolutely depends on it

* **Democrats are outraising Republicans 2-1 most months, sometimes it can even be as high as 3-1**

That’s why I’m reaching out today. The stakes are as high now as they were in 2021, **[yet 88% of our supporters who gave then aren’t giving now](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=8ec98f1519494828b0cea6ba53edf1a4&_e=-jnE4Nw5MKWIj-KeC_Cep4IAwaRLx_c36aD4P3ld07zw1b76XLp_puV3x-oJ2pAeBjuagj3Bw8ORm9A9jCtUCkxNuOPK5L5_t7ViqctSLU3XmZcKk2iBEYLlJGsqiNAzy0AWRyNKe7bkfgRHjDyQi2UtsMsP-1hbofDswFKW0Csl-Zmxfg3cpY-da1IlwKHBbtUR8FpRWzI9rNQD573iG1UrPvmmuEbn6QpmuQWKouIhOB7J0a89a6Rtf8dBbRnW-F2w-idDTWrqlS1A81bdj1ONVkWy1QZ6rqGGdk7ShJj_IzgrznrXW_lTGv32P2hydioM6u2INb4i0oVGQw4A90ba-Wf7maPl3PwWAjkzALHYQEv1q-8FqaJw8aPXPd8O-ziRKkM7TSr-blA0kgIbthOJaAcXAJKX-X-_pKZ9Cc55OQLA12m31vAK_6ouPd3l)**. ## Congress Passes Record Defense Bill
The House and Senate approved a record-high [$886 billion defense policy bill](http://trk.secureandprosper._EUXZGaQDw), up 3% from last year. It includes a 5.2% pay raise for troops, the biggest pay boost in decades. The bill passed in the Senate 87-13 and the House 310-118, despite concerns from some GOP members that the bill keeps intact Pentagon "social-engineering" policies, such as abortion access. Rep. Mike Rogers, chairman of the House Armed Services Committee, said he was "disappointed" the House didn't get all it wanted but that the bill was ["a good compromise."](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
## Wisconsin Trades Diversity for Cash
The Wisconsin Board of Regents reversed itself and [approved a state GOP deal](http://trk.secureandprosper.-GHRorrRD9Cm6YKZg) for $800 million in university funding in exchange for freezing new hires of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) officers. Additionally, 43 existing DEI jobs will be reclassified to new positions, and campuses will have to eliminate statements supporting "diversity" on student applications. The state legislature refused to approve the $800 million budget increase for pay raises and capitol improvements without the DEI deal. The Board of Regents initially turned it down but [reversed the decision](http://trk.secureandprosper._Lm9ybpA) in a surprise vote Wednesday.
## Mickey Mouse Losing Copyright Protection
After 95 years, the original version of Mickey Mouse is finally losing copyright protection and [entering the public domain](http://trk.secureandprosper._FBQ), where anyone can use the character as long as it doesn't appear to come from Disney. Mickey's first appearance was in the primitive 1928 cartoon ["Steamboat Willie,"](http://trk.secureandprosper.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6NTE5ODk2OTgsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM4ODM3MTYzNCIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMzQ5LThkODY5NDViMWU0ZTQ1NDdhMzBmNWFlYWUyZjFmZjhhIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEwIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1CQmdnaG5RRjZFNCJ9/c5mxvxBYDSrF5FVS4uJi2Q) and that's the only version that's entering the public domain -- the sweet, hapless Mickey from the 1930s on is still protected. Another character that recently entered the public domain is Winnie the Pooh. He and Piglet were immediately reimagined as bloodthirsty villains in the slasher film ["Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey."](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

# Join in on the Holiday Spirit 🎁
Dear Supporters,
As we approach the holiday season, I hope this message finds you surrounded by warmth and joy with your loved ones. It's hard to believe that we're nearing the end of the year already! As we reflect on the progress our campaign has made, I am overwhelmed with gratitude for the unwavering support our team has received.
[**If you scroll the the bottom of this email you can learn more about me, my background, and what makes me the best Republican candidate to win Maryland’s 6th Congressional District! ⬇️ ⬇️**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c17f4de218&e=0a12281e0e)
Thanks to your incredible generosity and dedication, our fundraising efforts have been nothing short of amazing. We are on the brink of reaching yet another significant milestone for our campaign. Your contributions have brought us closer to our goals, but there's a final push needed to achieve our target.
As we gear up for the new year and the critical 2024 election, I am thrilled by the momentum we've gained. Every donation propels us forward, inching us closer to securing the Republican nomination for Maryland’s 6th and being the Republican candidate who can truly win this seat. We have a real opportunity to make a difference, and your support is crucial in ensuring our success.
At this pivotal moment, we find ourselves just $10,000 away from our year-end goal. With your continued support, we can make this a reality. Your contribution, no matter the size, will play a pivotal role in sending the strongest Republican candidate through the primary and positioning us strongly for the upcoming 2024 election.
[**Send the Roca for Congress campaign an early Christmas gift by making a donation today!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f9e31f263a&e=0a12281e0e) 🎁
Let's join forces and carry this momentum into the holiday season. Together, we can ensure a brighter future for our community and our nation.Please consider making a contribution today and spreading the word among your friends and family. Your support is invaluable.
Thank you for being an integral part of this journey. Wishing you and your loved ones a joyous holiday season filled with love, laughter, and hope for a brighter future.
Sincerely,
Mariela Roca
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=75d086e51e&e=0a12281e0e)
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=bb14d37e34&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=5fc1f4a55f&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2283386bf7&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=241d600a09&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ed3287ca7d&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=47ac550ee0&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0c900e3799&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a90f794510&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0b227364f3&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a037b49a7f&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=27d5b62f5f&e=0a12281e0e)

But I think they’re asking the wrong question. The question they should be asking is: “ _How can you make an impact outside of Congress?”_ The reality is I’m not in Congress right now. Peter,
Today is Bill of Rights Day, a day in our nation's history that reminds us of the fundamental principles upon which our great nation was built.

On December 15, 1791, the first ten amendments to the United States Constitution, collectively known as the Bill of Rights, were ratified. These amendments guarantee essential rights and protections that are the bedrock of our democracy. As your representative in Congress, I am committed to upholding and defending these rights to ensure that the principles of freedom, liberty, and justice endure for generations to come.

The Bill of Rights serves as a testament to the foresight of our Founding Fathers, who understood the importance of safeguarding individual liberties against the potential encroachment of government power. Today, as we reflect on these ten amendments, it is essential that we remain vigilant in defending our rights and liberties from any threat, whether foreign or domestic.

As your Congressman, I am dedicated to working tirelessly to protect the rights of every American. Whether it's the freedom of speech, the right to bear arms, or the protection against unreasonable searches and seizures, each right enumerated in the Bill of Rights plays a crucial role in preserving the principles that make our country exceptional.

I encourage you to take a moment on Bill of Rights Day to reflect on the significance of these foundational freedoms. Let us renew our commitment to defending the principles that have shaped our nation and continue to inspire people around the world.

Thank you for the trust you have placed in me as your representative.

Together, let us celebrate Bill of Rights Day and reaffirm our dedication to the principles that make America the land of the free and the home of the brave.

Best,

clean_body: | | | | Protecting Our Freedoms Peter, Today is Bill of Rights Day, a day in our nation's history that reminds us of the fundamental principles upon which our great nation was built. On December 15, 1791, the first ten amendments to the United States Constitution, collectively known as the Bill of Rights, were ratified. These amendments guarantee essential rights and protections that are the bedrock of our democracy. As your representative in Congress, I am committed to upholding and defending these rights to ensure that the principles of freedom, liberty, and justice endure for generations to come. The Bill of Rights serves as a testament to the foresight of our Founding Fathers, who understood the importance of safeguarding individual liberties against the potential encroachment of government power. Today, as we reflect on these ten amendments, it is essential that we remain vigilant in defending our rights and liberties from any threat, whether foreign or domestic. As your Congressman, I am dedicated to working tirelessly to protect the rights of every American. Whether it's the freedom of speech, the right to bear arms, or the protection against unreasonable searches and seizures, each right enumerated in the Bill of Rights plays a crucial role in preserving the principles that make our country exceptional. I encourage you to take a moment on Bill of Rights Day to reflect on the significance of these foundational freedoms. Let us renew our commitment to defending the principles that have shaped our nation and continue to inspire people around the world. Thank you for the trust you have placed in me as your representative. Together, let us celebrate Bill of Rights Day and reaffirm our dedication to the principles that make America the land of the free and the home of the brave. Best, Rep. Roger Williams TX-25 | Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Get to Know Ron DeSantis Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children. On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now. #
Folks — We have a big mid-month fundraising deadline tonight. In fact, it’s the last one of 2023! **For the last time before our deadline,[I’m going to ask you to pitch in to my work to defend the Democratic Senate Majority. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75227664/444034329/-726943547?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_GEN_MMG_AC60_20231215_AM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjg2Y2Y0NS02ZTliLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V6FyxxAox9wA-YicJAwla6cutK6RT0gbTS2uAJoJduk=)** I’ll be frank: The Senate map next year is tough for Democrats. We have 23 Democratic-held seats on the ballot in some competitive states like Nevada, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Ohio. **But here’s what keeps me going: The American people, over and over again, have said resoundingly that they want to keep making progress. And Democrats are the ones making that progress.** From fighting the climate crisis to lowering the cost of groceries, from defending abortion access to passing legislation to protect our kids from gun violence, Democrats are making a difference. _Here’s where you come in, team._ **I’m an organizer at heart. The 2024 legislative session is just one month away and the Democrats are already playing defense as we get six initiatives qualified.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| This week House Republicans voted to authorize an impeachment inquiry into President Biden. This is a necessary step to force the White House to comply with the House Oversight Committee's investigation into Biden family corruption. Some Democrats are going to say there is no evidence against Joe Biden, and that Republicans are wasting time on a wild politically motivated goose chase. I'd be the first one to tell you if this vote was politically motivated and unwarranted. But this impeachment inquiry is absolutely justified. Here are just a *few* of the findings from the House Oversight Committee:
* 20 shell companies created by the Biden family, mostly while he was VP

* Biden's home address listed as the beneficiary address for two wire transfers from China, totaling OVER $250,000

* The Biden family and their associates raked in over $24M from foreign governments between 2015-2019

* A direct payment of $200,000 to Joe Biden

* $40,000 in laundered China money

...Again, these are only a few of the findings. There's enough smoke here to warrant a real investigation with some real subpoena power.

| My legislation to provide grants for further research into the use of psychedelics to treat active-duty service members suffering from PTSD and TBI was passed by Congress this week as part of the NDAA.
For years, veterans and private sector citizens have had access to similar clinical trials, with phenomenal results. Recent Phase 3 clinical trials with MDMA found that 86% of the study participants had reduced PTSD symptoms and 71% didn't even qualify as having PTSD anymore. I personally know many veterans whose lives were saved by just a few treatments.
Many active-duty service members are suffering the same demons that follow us home from war - but they cannot legally access psychedelic therapies. Their only option is to visit clinics outside the U.S. and risk being discharged from the military. Our service members deserve better.
This legislation is not about legalization or recreational use. It's about honoring our promise to our military families and fighting back against the high incidence of suicide in the military community.

| House Republicans have a historic opportunity to force Biden and the Democrats to pass border security. But we have to use negotiations over additional Ukraine aid to get border security measures passed into law.
There's a sensible deal that can be made if the Speaker takes action and starts negotiations. Letting the Senate negotiate was never going to work. Why? Because Senate Democrats don't have enough incentive. They'll get re-elected. But Biden won't, especially if the border crisis continues through the election season.
Some "hardliners" on our side are scoffing at the idea of trying to get a deal on the border done in exchange for Ukraine aid.
