clean_body: | | | | | | | | == | Peter – This week, House Republicans authorized an impeachment inquiry into President Biden - a necessary step to force the White House to comply with our investigation into Biden family corruption. Congress passed my legislation to fund research into psychedelic treatment studies for active duty service members suffering from PTSD and traumatic brain injury. And I called on Republican leadership to seize a historic opportunity to force Biden and the Democrats to secure our southern border. Since announcing my re-election campaign last week, I've been filled with gratitude by the outpouring of support from my constituents, donors, and supporters from across the country who say they've got my back. We need serious legislators - not political opportunists who want to be social media stars - to do real work in Congress for the American people. If you are able to contribute even a small donation to my re-election campaign, I promise I won't let you down in the fight for the most important issues our country faces in the coming years. You can donate at this link: | | | == | As always, thank you for your continued support. Now, here's your brief. | | | | | | | | WHY I VOTED TO AUTHORIZE AN IMPEACHMENT INQUIRY INTO BIDEN | == | | | == | | | This week House Republicans voted to authorize an impeachment inquiry into President Biden. This is a necessary step to force the White House to comply with the House Oversight Committee's investigation into Biden family corruption. Some Democrats are going to say there is no evidence against Joe Biden, and that Republicans are wasting time on a wild politically motivated goose chase. I'd be the first one to tell you if this vote was politically motivated and unwarranted. But this impeachment inquiry is absolutely justified. Here are just a few of the findings from the House Oversight Committee: 20 shell companies created by the Biden family, mostly while he was VP Biden's home address listed as the beneficiary address for two wire transfers from China, totaling OVER $250,000 The Biden family and their associates raked in over $24M from foreign governments between 2015-2019 A direct payment of $200,000 to Joe Biden * $40,000 in laundered China money ...Again, these are only a few of the findings. There's enough smoke here to warrant a real investigation with some real subpoena power. | | | | | | | | MY BILL TO STUDY PSYCHEDELIC TREATMENT FOR ACTIVE DUTY SERVICE MEMBERS PASSES CONGRESS | == | == | My legislation to provide grants for further research into the use of psychedelics to treat active-duty service members suffering from PTSD and TBI was passed by Congress this week as part of the NDAA. For years, veterans and private sector citizens have had access to similar clinical trials, with phenomenal results. Recent Phase 3 clinical trials with MDMA found that 86% of the study participants had reduced PTSD symptoms and 71% didn't even qualify as having PTSD anymore. I personally know many veterans whose lives were saved by just a few treatments. Many active-duty service members are suffering the same demons that follow us home from war - but they cannot legally access psychedelic therapies. Their only option is to visit clinics outside the U.S. and risk being discharged from the military. Our service members deserve better. This legislation is not about legalization or recreational use. It's about honoring our promise to our military families and fighting back against the high incidence of suicide in the military community. | | | | | | NO UKRAINE FUNDING WITHOUT BORDER SECURITY | == | == | House Republicans have a historic opportunity to force Biden and the Democrats to pass border security. But we have to use negotiations over additional Ukraine aid to get border security measures passed into law. There's a sensible deal that can be made if the Speaker takes action and starts negotiations. Letting the Senate negotiate was never going to work. Why? Because Senate Democrats don't have enough incentive. They'll get re-elected. But Biden won't, especially if the border crisis continues through the election season. Some "hardliners" on our side are scoffing at the idea of trying to get a deal on the border done in exchange for Ukraine aid. They say the topic of Ukraine aid is too toxic and so they can't even support border policy changes if it has Ukraine aid attached. Ok, well that should tell you that they don't actually want the border situation to improve. Because Ukraine aid is the only available option for us to make some changes, whether you like that reality or not. | | | | | | | | == | | | == | My custom eyepatch is back in stock - with options for left or right eye. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34816%2E3422442%2EiHfWhw)
Impact: I despise the word.
**It’s a popular word in political communications, but “impact” is what meteorites do.** I always want to go beyond and explain the actual effect of something, whether that thing is legislation or your donation.
High food prices, for example, don’t just impact people. They cause kids to go to school without breakfast and force families to forgo expensive produce. But those high prices also mean multinational food producers post record profits, and CEOs might get a new yacht. Everyone is impacted, but it’s not the same.
When it comes to your contributions to our campaign, your donations don’t just impact this race. They:
* Allow us to run ads, send texts, and make phone calls to voters.
* Enable us to reach voters at key moments in the race.
* Prove campaigns don’t need corporate cash to be successful.

I always want to go beyond and explain the actual effect of something, whether that thing is legislation or your donation. High food prices, for example, don’t just impact people. But those high prices also mean multinational food producers post record profits, and CEOs might get a new yacht. Everyone is impacted, but it’s not the same. # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=1391%2E552475%2Eb3sucB)
Peter,
I love history, especially Pennsylvania history. I share facts with pretty much anyone who will listen. Just ask Terese and my daughters.
That’s why I couldn’t pass up the opportunity to share a piece of history with you today, Peter.
On this day in 1791, the Bill of Rights was ratified, guaranteeing many of the freedoms and liberties that Americans cherish today – rights such as the freedom of speech, religion, and press.
These 10 amendments, drafted separately from the Constitution, represent the first steps taken to creating a more perfect Union.
As your Senator, I go to Washington every day to protect these fundamental rights and more. Pennsylvanians put their trust in me to fight for what’s right, and that’s not something I take lightly.
I’m running for re-election because I want to continue to fight for _all_ Pennsylvanians in the Senate, but this is going to be the toughest race of my career, and I can’t win it alone.
[**Can I count on you to chip in $5 or whatever you can today so I can continue fighting for working families across the Commonwealth?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231215-2?refcode=em20231215-2&recurring=yes&refcode2=1391_552475_b3sucB&akid=1391%2E552475%2Eb3sucB)

body:
don’t miss out on this exclusive chance to sign a letter showing your thanks for the Bidens!
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH)
---
Out of thousands of Democrats, YOU were selected from your state to sign this exclusive letter showing your thanks to the Bidens – _so we’re really counting on you to take up this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!_ [**_The letter is closing at 8 PM SHARP so please don’t waste a second »_**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=7&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH) | [ Show your support for the Biden's commitment to protecting our democracy by chipping in $7 and signing the card now! »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=8&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH)
---
**TO:** President Joe and First Lady Jill Biden
**FROM:** A Grateful Democrat
**Subject:** I’M THANKFUL FOR YOU THIS HOLIDAY SEASON! Dear President Biden and First Lady Jill Biden,

This Holiday season is filled with joy, hope, and good tidings all because of your hard work and dedication to serving the American people.

For that, I would like to personally say THANK YOU! [**_Despite the relentless attacks you face from MAGA Republicans, you continue to prioritize unity, protecting our freedoms, and putting people over politics. So I’m signing this card and chipping in $7 to Fight for Reform to continue to invest in critical state and local battleground races across the nation to show that Democrats will continue to stand behind your historic agenda. »_**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=9&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH) | [Donate $7 to support our work now »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=10&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH)
---
**President Biden:** You led our country out of a pandemic and strengthened our economy all while passing a historic agenda – _giving the American people a light in the darkness amidst ongoing MAGA Republican chaos!_

**Dr. Biden,** you continue to set an example of what leadership looks like, confronting every challenge with dignity and grace!

**The major wins we’ve witnessed for Democrats across the board in November’s elections are a testimony that voters are beyond pleased with your historic agenda and leadership.**

And although we anticipate the challenges awaiting us in the new year, we are ready to face them head-on knowing that your empowering and unwavering leadership will help us overcome anything.
[**_Happy Holidays to you both, and THANK YOU for how you continue to show up for the American people!_**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=11&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH)
**_X A Grateful Democrat_**
[Donate $7 to support our work now »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/34448?t=12&akid=20522%2E4449941%2EQi3zQH)
---

| | **Another Woke Spending Spree 💸**
---
---
| | They sold you out, folks—and there’s no excuse. After months of trying my hardest to get a piece of legislation that actually benefits the American people, Congress pulled a fast one on us. We’re stuck with a stocking full of coal this Christmas season, and to no one’s surprise, President Biden will give it his stamp of approval in no time. The National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) is [$886 billion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=518df8e5ded1492680160656d30363f6&_e=16i3hus-GxqzZ3h54lfzwuxaJwg_X6UYM26crz82geq6DmXMhZ2Xi7pX1T99MDCLlB1MNjM9f2-81y4E6KFywpBJ5SEr7Sg1uKphqT-41WTM06p6wkmw3OmYn4KJSxOXh7sta1fwOffQXC_okV8_sQqnXUsGijRgYTsgshyQGQ-Rdnstr8kIESaoNTmx8Q95uoRLoxxe5vGonMBwC7PmaUTz6eiX1QDFO8sYOCdDGodJB7F8UqdZ4hfOPKSSYpYyICPStgTLdGh9yZhI5tMAWW1e-tjzfTulr8VkHSpVMDwbo0Tz2PZZCNakKFPVnT4PnmeRzxtsFvB2tHa1s-nxh4GVSkey5kvn6VQihASQ7jw%3D) worth of nonsense. There’s a boatload of garbage in this bill, but let’s unpack some of the biggest loads of liberal crap. First off, it will pour more cash into extending [FISA](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=518df8e5ded1492680160656d30363f6&_e=16i3hus-GxqzZ3h54lfzwuq6m4AzGOMQ0p55E65cHb3EXqsXYBbOaLJ8vDkG2OAR-iw4I5aDkdX1LMDrxnJ-_-qJCuLmGO14vKw4MDFPLuKGL9_P2lEKCdajq8NuMpILXx2DysngPuUv8cGvJAUccYDgGSIMPYCkscacukccwmK6AMxBPy5h4P-xXvXtzGoio_CZgy6worv0srSG3VAXz2PHxZDkJLaZs-lv6wL16lYcB9Py-E2MwMrP8jVsS23riNGJ72kujRDHnN8jxQ6AhtbuVJUu1MH3O0XlizxlT5dHJdATZXetYI0JpRV0O_SvymBZD9XjeIy2Y7VlmdRjTg%3D%3D), a surveillance program that practically hands the FBI a magnifying glass to peer into our lives. Sure, they claim they’re on the God-honest hunt for terrorists, but they’re really threatening the privacy of everyday Americans. If you’re caught in a conversation with someone they _might_ suspect, you’re under their dadgum microscope—and the alphabet agencies have a very different standard than most of us when it comes to who is a “danger.” They [exploited FISA to eavesdrop on the Trump campaign](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=518df8e5ded1492680160656d30363f6&_e=16i3hus-GxqzZ3h54lfzws3fCjyXnDNi6Bu8C4Hl06Yo2ZTpLoBzdA2Ibb3-RzNjoaKWwk4QgRjTJNpgR9pxMk61xoYFqFlMzXNUyZsjP39EcVkdCzZQUle28D3wfBy5psdZWhdgLDtmj86Qv9OMUYTre9F2ILqOrXT-OpjWNdtY0pVKAuuQf1ja5XSsaZR9ISlngWOtrbR9vejmz96Jq7wT_8NmWKw6zRfDGsoOT6_LeIHGcWmedNzNuMbwVElwBU5YkdO-wtezpc9-zaXiAiOqIwkpB3gxTlwumh6yAJ23en_EIgkD6uztnDNFJZPq) and to wrongfully dig into [millions of Americans](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=518df8e5ded1492680160656d30363f6&_e=16i3hus-GxqzZ3h54lfzwlwFE88I9BNhIChcGgNJRZJH8Xp82QKI7agMFfGG7d1NrLzAjOFWiAFgkRvMmu4HjU6ftUASLKGCY3f6fQX7YMK5h4yHVnKYbNBitK39Qlh9F5ltsUxAiALCAt_ATps4laGZCn6gTbml7XtMwyKHJ2P097PNkAciU9hlbIQnLQOMhRa8Z_prrcmwIV1mGZOw4h6nEigpyUKSJVj0r8_VcQEGQk2P9BtCzaQ3tQJkKC41yBHq7AMclQvnHiAOjxDGewNKmSNuzil9xJUIGaiAtzw%3D)’ emails and online records. name: DC Daily Journal
subject: Never eat almonds, spinach and peanut butter (Here's why)
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

If you been led to believe that
peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's
email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3
healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your
body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

1. Peanut butter

While peanut butter does contain
a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons
outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one
of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin
that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high
in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut
butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much
omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and
this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain
inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most
people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we
should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also
contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based
antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to
kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in
the next food...

2. Spinach

Spinach is promoted as a healthy
green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach
is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by
modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and
other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in
a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally
Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot
of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning
spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too
much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as
kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

3. Almonds

Although almonds and almond milk
are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides,
including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much
omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet
occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often
because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun
little quiz below and a few more foods...

Bananas vs oranges vs apples...
(the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones. Both sapping you of energy and forcing
your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned
off" with normal diet and exercise.

Do you know the fruit I'm talking
about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it
is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

>> Bananas

>> Oranges

>> Apples

>> Grapes

But that's the power of this grassroots movement – it's made up of folks like you who believe in this fight and chip in what they can, when they can.

This movement is how we're going to defy the pundits who are calling me one of the most vulnerable senators in the country, win in Ohio, and defend our Senate majority.

#
Friend,
In just a minute, I’m going to ask you to contribute $3 to support our movement ahead of our mid-month deadline at midnight.
But first, please give me a chance to explain why this request is so important, especially today.
December is a busy month for many, my family included, because of the holidays and the upcoming new year.
But in the political world, it's a critical time. Not only is it our last chance to fundraise and gather the resources we need before the election year. But it’s an official FEC fundraising deadline month, and our final opportunity to report strong fundraising data to the country.
When it’s over, we’re legally required to report how much money we’ve raised, and even more importantly, how many donations we’ve received.
But right now, we’re starting this month slower than we anticipated, which means we need to pick up the pace or risk falling behind. And I mean it when I say we can’t let that happen — there is simply too much at stake.
[**So can you please contribute $3 or whatever you can afford to our movement before our mid-month deadline at midnight?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=1&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1271?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.D8m-8r&amount=3&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=20&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)

[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.bYri1I&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=23&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.77Xyel&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=24&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=25&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)
The fundraising numbers we report at the end of the month not only translate to the momentum of our movement but will show the press, political pundits, and naysayers the scope of our impact on close races — races that will determine the outcome of the House and Senate majorities.
The stronger the number we put out, the greater the impact we can make on critical races in 2024.
So as we approach our midmonth fundraising cut-off at midnight, leaving us just two weeks from the FEC deadline, I’m asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 to our movement today? We have a gap to close if we want to report strong fundraising numbers, and need a big day here to stay on track.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231215-1-t2&t=26&akid=5075%2E196590%2EsXsKD5)

Thank you for your continued support. Let’s finish this year off strong.
Mandela

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Can we be real with you for a moment?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves.
#
Can we be real with you for a moment?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves. We understand how people can get frustrated. But let us explain why this is vital.
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, you will. That’s how this transformative movement works. **It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
Right now, we’re approaching our December mid-month deadline, and we’re hoping to hit our goal before today ends. The only way we can get there is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. [If you have the means, can you donate $5 right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231215.6K3vsS&refcode=em20231215-5484-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5484%2E2526796%2EVAjb48)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231215.6K3vsS&refcode=em20231215-5484-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5484%2E2526796%2EVAjb48)**
We’re not exaggerating. Most members of Congress fuel their reelection campaigns by dedicating hours of their time asking rich donors for $500, $1000, or even $2900 donations.
**Alexandria is different.** This whole movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a campaign that is...
\- Raising resources, recruiting volunteers, and making calls to help elect progressive allies across Congress, and build a progressive majority.
\- Reaching out to communities across NY-14 to spread awareness about the Green New Deal, how to influence local, state, and federal leaders, and more.
\- Raising money for community projects like providing students with backpacks and families with a Thanksgiving dinner.
\- Working day and night to keep Alexandria in Congress and show the world what we can do.
There are more than enough people reading this email that, if they just donated whatever they can spare, we’d be on track to reach our mid-month month. [If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231215.6K3vsS&refcode=em20231215-5484-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5484%2E2526796%2EVAjb48)
Thanks for reading,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20231215?refcode=em20231215-5484-P_FND_MMF_GOL&t=22&refcode2=5484_2526796_VAjb48&akid=5484%2E2526796%2EVAjb48)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20231215-5484-P_FND_MMF_GOL&t=23&akid=5484%2E2526796%2EVAjb48)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Yesterday, UAW renewed their call for a permanent ceasefire and urged
others to join our fight for humanity.

UAW President Shawn Fain stood side by side with members of Congress,
including Justice Democrats incumbents Cori Bush, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida
Tlaib, and urged more of our elected leaders and the rest of the labor
movement to join us in our demands for:

* A permanent ceasefire in Israel and Palestine to end the
indiscriminate slaughter of thousands of innocent civilians;
* The safe release of all hostages;
* Water, food, fuel, and humanitarian aid to enter Gaza.

Fain said, “As union members, we know we must fight for all workers and
suffering people around the world. We must fight for humanity.” And he’s
right.

Together, we are a diverse movement of working people in the collective
fight for peace and social justice for all.

Squad members like Cori and Rashida led the way on introducing a ceasefire
resolution in Congress, and through our continued organizing and public
pressure, the ceasefire movement continues to grow despite attacks from
pro-war groups like AIPAC.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231215.1UnClB&refcode=em20231215-32345&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32345%2E1203867%2EJ_rpUB ]Support our work to keep up our shared fight for humanity and re-elect
pro-peace champions to Congress in the New Year: pitch in a grassroots
contribution of $3 or more today.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231215.1UnClB&refcode=em20231215-32345&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1020&akid=32345%2E1203867%2EJ_rpUB ]Contribute $3

With your support, Justice Democrats will continue to give everything
we’ve got to defend our progressive leaders in Congress who
unapologetically stand up for the human rights of all.

In solidarity,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1021&akid=32345%2E1203867%2EJ_rpUB ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1022&akid=32345%2E1203867%2EJ_rpUB ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Peter,
Today on Bill of Rights Day, I am reminded of the fundamental principles that shape our nation and safeguard the liberties we hold dear. On this significant occasion, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the enduring legacy of our Constitution and the vital role it plays in preserving the rights and freedoms of every American.

The Bill of Rights, comprising the first ten amendments to the Constitution, stands as a testament to our commitment to individual liberties, justice, and the rule of law. It serves as a guiding light, ensuring that our government respects and protects the rights of its citizens. Today, as we celebrate the 232nd anniversary of the ratification of the Bill of Rights, let us recommit ourselves to upholding the principles enshrined in this foundational document.

In Oregon, we understand the importance of a government that listens to its people and respects their rights. Our diverse communities, rich landscapes, and vibrant cities contribute to the unique tapestry that is the Beaver State. As your representative, it is my duty and privilege to work tirelessly to protect the values that make Oregon exceptional and ensure that your voices are heard in the halls of Congress.

As we celebrate this important day, let us remain steadfast in our commitment to justice, equality, and the pursuit of happiness for all.

_**Together, we can build a brighter future for Oregon and our great nation.
**_
Thank you for the trust you have placed in me to represent you in Congress. It is an honor and privilege that I take very seriously.

clean_body: | | | | Peter, Today on Bill of Rights Day, I am reminded of the fundamental principles that shape our nation and safeguard the liberties we hold dear. On this significant occasion, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the enduring legacy of our Constitution and the vital role it plays in preserving the rights and freedoms of every American. The Bill of Rights, comprising the first ten amendments to the Constitution, stands as a testament to our commitment to individual liberties, justice, and the rule of law. It serves as a guiding light, ensuring that our government respects and protects the rights of its citizens. Today, as we celebrate the 232nd anniversary of the ratification of the Bill of Rights, let us recommit ourselves to upholding the principles enshrined in this foundational document. In Oregon, we understand the importance of a government that listens to its people and respects their rights. Our diverse communities, rich landscapes, and vibrant cities contribute to the unique tapestry that is the Beaver State. As your representative, it is my duty and privilege to work tirelessly to protect the values that make Oregon exceptional and ensure that your voices are heard in the halls of Congress. As we celebrate this important day, let us remain steadfast in our commitment to justice, equality, and the pursuit of happiness for all. Together, we can build a brighter future for Oregon and our great nation. Thank you for the trust you have placed in me to represent you in Congress. It is an honor and privilege that I take very seriously. Wishing you and your loved ones a joyous Bill of Rights Day. Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. clean_body: Peter, First, during the 2016 campaign and throughout the Trump presidency, the media obsessively covered Trump's divisive and often dangerous behavior because it brought a surge in viewers and online clicks. Then, Trump lost in 2020. Fox News and the right-wing media responded by pushing the Big Lie that directly led to the violence we saw at the Capitol on January 6th. Now, Trump, the front-runner again, is facing 91 felony charges in four separate cases, making an urgent and unprecedented moment. It’s no exaggeration to say that the media’s response to this will have a dramatic impact on the future of our democracy. 2024 is the news media’s biggest test in the history of our democracy. The bad news is that there’s already evidence that they’re failing. The good news is that Courier’s talented teams of journalists are already working around the clock to pick up their slack. = Donald Trump has made it very clear. If re-elected, he’s promised that his top priority will be revenge and retribution against his perceived enemies. That’s not a political platform, that’s literal fascism. We’re not afraid to say that, but will the mainstream media? Recent history says the chances aren’t good. That’s why we need your support right now. This lawsuit is just one of _many_ that Trump is involved in now, and the American people deserve to hear him try and defend himself on the stand. He may claim that the litany of charges that he’s facing are just a big joke, but we know better. **[**Trump needs to take the witness stand and under oath tell the American people about what a fraud he is. If you agree, sign our petition to show your support.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75235694/444059443/-1650877580?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEwZGU5NGNhLTdjOWItZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=nzkk3DZIK6NFWyvoy1lIRkTMffToe-TYwq4ZmQusP2k=&emci=46756f88-6b9b-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=10de94ca-7c9b-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=14405814)** This is a case that could result in a _$250 million_ fine and Trump losing his New York real estate license. By Trump refusing to take the witness stand he continues to be able to hide his secrets. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. name: Vice President Kamala Harris
subject: What’s happening in Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
I’m writing today to tell you about a young woman in Texas named Kate Cox, and how her state has failed her | | |
---
Peter, I hope that you’ll give me a moment of your time today to share the story of a young woman in Texas by the name of Kate Cox. Kate is a mother of two. She and her husband were excited to be expecting again. But sadly, early on in her pregnancy, Kate’s physician identified that carrying that pregnancy to term could result in harm to Kate. So, Kate sought out an abortion. Unfortunately, Kate currently lives in Texas – a state that criminalizes access to abortion. **So strictly, in fact, that _physicians can face life in prison for providing care to women._** Because of Texas’s policies, Kate was stuck in legal limbo for weeks trying to determine how to get the care she needed. As a result, she had to travel to another state to receive the health care she needed. Peter, I think it’s important to share Kate’s story. Dear Peter,
Today, on Bill of Rights Day, we honor the foundational principles that have shaped our great nation. In Washington's 8th Congressional district, we not only celebrate these historic freedoms but also reaffirm our commitment to protecting them for every citizen.
The Bill of Rights symbolizes our enduring values: freedom of speech, religion, and the press; the right to peaceful assembly and to petition the government; and the protection against unwarranted government intrusion. These rights are as relevant today as they were over two centuries ago.
Our campaign is dedicated to upholding these principles, ensuring they are preserved, protected, and passed down to future generations. But this work requires more than words; it demands action and support.
In observance of Bill of Rights Day, we invite you to contribute $20, $50, or $100 to help us continue advocating for our fundamental rights and freedoms.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. subject: Legislative Session Update
body:
News from the Capital | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12-15-23?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| District 24,

**Thank you for reading this weekly update!** I had a busy week in Tallahassee, meeting with my fellow legislators for committee meetings and talking to constituents and stakeholders about their legislative priorities. I look forward to keeping you updated on my work in the Florida House.

**As always, if there is an issue you would like me to address in Tallahassee, please contact me.** It would be a pleasure to meet with you! I want to ensure our district and state stay strong for the next generation of Floridians.
---
| | **MEETINGS WITH CONSTITUENTS AND ORGANIZATIONS**
---
| **On Tuesday, I had several meetings with constituents and organizations.**

**That morning, I met with the Second Harvest Food Bank to discuss their work in Marion County **along with what appropriations they have requested for this year. More than 40 local nonprofit food provider partners in the Greater Ocala area now receive food resources for their clients facing hunger from Second Harvest Food Bank's Marion Branch.

**If you are looking for a meaningful way to help fight hunger, especially during this holiday season, 100% of your contribution stays in Marion County and helps families right here at home.** Your generosity translates directly into more meals for families, kids, seniors, veterans, and others who are facing hunger in our community.
---
|
---
| | **I also met with the Florida Chamber of Commerce on Tuesday morning to discuss bills being seen in the Regulatory Reform & Economic Development Subcommittee.** As a member of this subcommittee, I look forward to promoting economic development throughout the state. The Florida Chamber and its members champion free enterprise every day. But free enterprise isn’t free. Unfortunately, there are a lot of forces wanting Florida to be like New York, California and Illinois. With businesses fleeing high-cost states and finding their way to the sunshine state to do business, the Florida Chambers works hard to make sure Florida remains Florida as we relaunch our economy back to pre-COVID numbers and beyond.
---
|
---
| **In the afternoon I met with the Florida Thoroughbred Breeders Association for introductions and to discuss legislative priorities for this upcoming Session.** FTBOA is a non-profit association representing over 1,300 thoroughbred breeders and owners in Florida, and are committed to making a positive impact in the Thoroughbred community. They enhance the Florida industry through diligence to the FTBOA mission and passion for world-class breeding and racing.
---
|
---
| **Wednesday was another busy day in Tallahassee** , with numerous meetings with constituents and organizations. I also had a committee to attend.

**Wednesday afternoon, I met with the Associated Builders and Contractors to discuss their top legislative priorities moving into Session. **

Did you know the construction industry will need to attract 650,000 additional workers in 2023? ABC’s 68 chapters and their affiliates offer more than 800 apprenticeship, craft, safety and construction management education programs—including over 450 government-registered apprenticeship programs—across the country. **Which construction careers are in the most demand right now? Visit [careerstarter.byf.org](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=e886794d29&e=d1c1b9864f "https://careerstarter.byf.org/?utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D") to find out! Explore programs near you: [abc.org/grapmap](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=7b4cd6d845&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.abc.org/Workforce/Chapter-Registered-Apprenticeship-Locator?utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**
---
|
---
|
---
| **I enjoyed my time at the Florida Leaders Holiday Reception held at the Governor’s Mansion on Wednesday evening.** It was great to spend time and fellowship with friends and colleagues from across the state, and I look forward to what we will accomplish together in the year to come.
---
|
---
| **I had a busy two weeks of committee meetings in Tallahassee.** My fellow legislators and I listened to several informative presentations from stakeholders seeking to improve Florida policy. In the **State Administration and Technology Appropriations Subcommittee** we reviewed the Governor's Recommended Budget for Fiscal Year 2024-2025 and were updated on the My Safe Florida Home Program, and we discussed ways to improve economic development throughout **Florida in the Regulatory Reform and Economic Development Subcommittee. **
---
|
---
| **Friends, as you can see, it was a busy week in Tallahassee serving our District and interests.** Now, we break for the holidays, but we will be back in Tallahassee at the start of the new year for the 2024 Legislative Session. I am honored to serve you as your State Representative. If I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b82643e581&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

I wish you all a very Happy Holiday Season!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---
| |
---

Once again I am the only Fmr elected State Delegate and candidate for Congress in CD6 standing for our Bill of Rights. Will you stand with me today? | | | |
---

|
## Bill of Rights Day - December 15, 1791.
Today is our Bill of Rights Day, remembering the freedoms we take for granted in the first 10 amendments to the Constitution.

Do you agree with me that we must defend our rights? Those include:
* the right to speak freely without retaliation,
* to religious faith and practice,
* press, assembly and petition,
* right to keep and bear arms,
* right to security in our homes and papers from government invasion and seizure,
* right to a jury trial, to public trials,
* right to due process and fundamental liberty interests and so much more...

[If so, I need your immediate contribution to win - click here.](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=5b8d664725&e=5bb5efcda7)
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=5828b61eec&e=5bb5efcda7)

Yesterday, Congress passed a violation of the Fourth Amendment, entitled FISA 702 \- granting continuing power to spy on you without the warrant requirement under probable cause via an illegal and unconstitutional scheme. This renewed extension of FISA 702 has been proven to have been previously used thousands of times in violation against Americans, including against President Trump.

As your next Congressman, I am the only candidate in this race committing to remove FISA 702 in the next defense bill. I will not let you down \- I will lead the fight to convince my colleagues to eliminate this unlawful and outrageous spying capability on American citizens.

And I have the experience to fight for you as I have:

>> Lead efforts to stop gun confiscation schemes in my Committee in Annapolis and _Cross-examined into silence a former ATF chief trying to confiscate_ and register our firearms in the Maryland Judiciary Committee.
>> Been fighting _ for over 19 years in state and federal courts defending clients under our Bill of Rights_ \- most recently winning two sidewalk counseling speech cases in Hagerstown.
>> _Stood as the First and Only State Delegate in Maryland history to file impeachment proceedings against a Governor who had trampled the Bill of Rights by ARRESTING Maryland citizens merely for exercising them_, all while being threatened myself by the same governor with ARREST for speaking for you if I left my home during his unconstitutional executive orders. _Not a single elected official joined me in this fight for YOU, but the impeachment effort won the praise of Marylanders and is part of Maryland history that We the People will not allow our God-given freedoms to be taken away by arbitrary government_.

_The lies in support of FISA 702_ claim it allows stopping terrorists and those who enter our country illegally. As President Trump's former Director of National Intelligence, Rick Grennell, has stated, this is false - our law already allows such authority outside of FISA 702. FISA 702 are secret courts. Director Grennell stated this week "there should not be any clean extension of FISA 702 under any circumstances - not even for a single day!" FISA 702 attempts to bypass the Fourth Amendment warrant requirement against Americans, not foreigners and terrorists. Again, they used this vehicle illegally against President Trump himself, so you should be sure the radical Left Deep State will spy on you.

On 7 November 1963 - just 15 days before he was assassinated, President John F. Kennedy taped a commemoration of the Bill of Rights to be aired on December 15, 1963. You can listen to it [here](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=704aeafe17&e=5bb5efcda7) and on the [JFK Library website](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=318def2a8d&e=5bb5efcda7).
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=944145de8a&e=5bb5efcda7)
President Ronald Reagan said in commemoration of this day and our Bill of Rights: "As our Founding Fathers taught us...liberty depends not upon the state but upon the people. Liberty thrives in the free association of citizens in free institutions."
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=52a82da6c6&e=5bb5efcda7)

President Donald J. Trump said last year on this occasion: "If we don't have Free Speech, we just don't have a country. It's as simple as that...That is why we must always defend our Bill of Rights. If we lose our right to speak freely, we lose every other right...like dominoes they all fall one by one." That is why he is running for re-election as our 47th President of the United States - to defend our country and Bill of Rights. And that is why I am running to be your next Congressman.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=db69cdd39d&e=5bb5efcda7)

Let us join together in the struggle and fight for our God-given Bill of Rights, lest we awaken one day and learn they are no more.

Freedom and victory,

Dan Cox, fmr. State Delegate (R-4)
Candidate for U.S. House of Representatives (MD-6)

P.S. I really do need your immediate contribution - if you agree with me that we must never give up our God-given freedoms. [Please stand with Valerie and me today in this race](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=6609b9df90&e=5bb5efcda7). Thank you.

FISA 702 attempts to bypass the Fourth Amendment warrant requirement against Americans, not foreigners and terrorists. It's as simple as that...That is why we must always defend our Bill of Rights. If we lose our right to speak freely, we lose every other right...like dominoes they all fall one by one." That is why he is running for re-election as our 47th President of the United States - to defend our country and Bill of Rights. And that is why I am running to be your next Congressman. Let us join together in the struggle and fight for our God-given Bill of Rights, lest we awaken one day and learn they are no more. Freedom and victory, Dan Cox, fmr. | | Peter, you are hearing a lot about goals and deadlines, and as Brian’s campaign manager, I wanted to make sure you know how we’re putting your contributions to work. These are a few line items on our campaign budget:
* **$26.94:** Six clipboards. Our volunteers are out knocking on doors across the district and they need the supplies to talk with voters. (Don’t worry, we have a lot more than six \- we just needed a few extra.)

* **$66:** 100 stamps. From thank you notes to our event hosts and donors, to campaign updates, we send a lot of mail, and your contribution helps make it happen.

* **$700:** One point of television. Dallas has one of the most expensive media markets in the country, and we need to make sure that Brian’s message reaches voters across the district.

My family lived in a small trailer in rural California where my brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table. When I was a teenager, I walked in the desert heat to different businesses asking them to invest in our community by investing in me and my dreams of a college education. Team,
My name is Trudy, and I am a proud mother of that courageous woman running to unseat Jim Jordan, Tamie WIlson. When she told me she was running I got excited because I know what a determined achiever she is.
I want to tell you more about Tamie, but when her team asked me to write about why I am so proud of my daughter and what I think of her stepping up to run for office a million things came to mind, but none show her loyalty, dedication, and fighting spirit more than how she has supported me through my ongoing battle with breast cancer.
Years ago, I was told that I had an advanced form of breast cancer that had gone undetected while my husband and I were underinsured. Because my husband was a small business owner, obtaining reliable and affordable health insurance before the Affordable Care Act was non-existent. Therefore, my ability to access preventive care and routine screenings for things like breast cancer was limited, and without obvious symptoms, I had no idea anything was wrong.
From the moment I first received my diagnosis, Tamie has been at my side every step of the way. She has slept in the chair next to my hospital bed everytime I've been admitted. I’ve always known her to be a fiercely loyal, loving person ever since she was just a small child.
We started calling her "The Child Advocate" when she was 8 years old because she was always helping someone. I think her experience and criticism as a biracial child made her more sensitive and aware of other people's need for inclusion and advocacy. She is a people person. She loves people and always wants everyone to be happy. I am filled with pride and admiration at the woman she is and the leader she has become.
Tamie has always been a go-getter. When she sets her mind to something she doesn't stop until she achieves it. When she was a child, we told Tamie she could do anything she set her mind to, and she believed us. HA!
Jim Jordan doesn't know who he's dealing with, but he's about to find out. I can't wait to see her win that seat and protect democracy. I know that Tamie will serve her constituents and our country well in Congress with the same kind of care, devotion, and love that she has always shown me and our family. **I hope that you will support her as she puts everything she has into this race.** She won’t let you down.

subject: Plastic Petition: Sign now to help save our oceans and end plastic pollution
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2201143?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **Baby sea turtles are CHOKING and DYING on plastic, Friend.** These precious little animals mistake plastic debris for food, which can obstruct their airways and digestive systems, puncture their internal organs, release toxic chemicals, or just directly trap and suffocate them. _**Then, when these helpless sea turtles DIE, their bodies decompose -- and the plastic _is released back into the ocean to KILL AGAIN!_**_ Every single minute, the equivalent of an _**entire garbage truck of plastic**_ makes its way into our oceans, **killing over a million sea creatures every year.** Plastic pollution is destroying our crucial oceanic ecosystems and harming the coastal communities and wildlife that rely on them. **_Defenseless sea turtles, dolphins, and other beloved marine animals are DESPERATE for help, Friend -- and they’re counting on activists like you to speak up for them today.[_Please don’t let our oceans down: Add your name to our petition now before our deadline at 11:59pm TONIGHT and help END the plastic pollution crisis that’s threatening our planet! >>_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2201144?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) _** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2201145?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Plastic doesn't decompose naturally, and instead, breaks down into tiny toxic microplastics that are accumulating and building up on our fragile Earth. _**It’s everywhere around you right now, Friend**_ \-- _**even ending up in our food, water, and air!**_
**Can you believe that the average person ingests a CREDIT CARD’S WORTH of plastic every week? **
The manufacturing of plastic itself burns through massive amounts of harmful fossil fuels, _exacerbating the climate crisis_ and _spewing toxic pollutants into the atmosphere._ As a result, the residents near these industrial-size factories, who are often from low-income communities of color, are left to bear the brunt of these serious health risks.
And while plastic overtakes every part of our lives and our planet, careless corporate polluters at Big Plastic and Big Oil are getting RICHER by selling and producing more and more plastic products without any regard for the environmental destruction. It’s time to hold the greedy plastic industry accountable before plastic completely demolishes everything we have left of this Earth. **But your signature is still missing from our plastic petition, Friend:** [**_Will you take urgent action right now to DEFEND people, wildlife, oceans, and our planet from a PLASTIC APOCALYPSE -- before it’s too late?_**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2201146?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

| **ABOUT BEN TOMA
**
Ben Toma’s family legally immigrated to the United States when he was just 9 years old. His family fled the dangers of communism at the time in Romania to seek freedom and build a new life here in America.

Ben is a small business owner and real estate broker, served on the Peoria City Council, and was appointed to the Arizona State House of Representatives in 2017. In 2018, Toma was elected in his own right and was quickly elevated to leadership roles by his peers. In the legislature, Toma authored and passed two landmark pieces of conservative legislation that were labeled “impossible” by both friend and foe.

Family matters took me to Texas just in time to witness the disgraceful and inhumane treatment of Kate Cox, a woman forced into a truly tragic dilemma both by nature and by MAGA Republicans.

Because of her courage this has become national news, and you probably know the story. In short, she is a mother who was pregnant and wants to become pregnant again. But her pregnancy became impossible. Her fetus had a fatal condition. Worse, if she carried the pregnancy to term, not only could she lose her own life but she could become incapable of having children in the future.

In Texas, she could only get an abortion by applying to the courts for an exception to that state’s extreme abortion ban. That in itself is a degrading humiliation. Even worse, the Texas Supreme Court, consisting of only Republicans, unanimously denied her petition, forcing her to leave the state to get the care she needed to save herself and her future children.

There are so many lessons to learn from this saga. Foremost is that MAGA Republican claims that they will compromise from their absolute determination to control women’s bodies are lies. If they cannot make an exception in this case, there is no hope they will make any exceptions ever.

MAGA Republicans are fond of calling Democrats “baby-killers,” which is another lie. This case makes plain that MAGA Republicans are “Mommy-killers,” which is true.

When someone else controls your body, you are a slave.

Today millions of women have lost control over their own bodies thanks to the extreme conservative MAGA Republicans who have turned the Supreme Court into the Extreme Court. It is the first time in American history that a right once recognized has been repealed.

Today millions of American women in MAGA Republican-controlled states have become slaves to Big Brother. MAGA Republicans have taken control over the most intimate decisions a woman can make.

As the son of an immigrant mother, husband, and father of two young women, I have always believed and strongly advocated for equal rights for all. I will not stand for this assault on women's rights!

Reproductive freedom is a fundamental right – the right to autonomy over our own bodies.

I will vote for both laws and a constitutional amendment to ensure that the reproductive freedom of women is once again guaranteed in America.

Friend -
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make your first online contribution to Elissa Slotkin, we think today should be the day.
Why?
CNN has called this seat one of the most likely to flip in 2024 — and as the only competitive open Senate seat in the country, this could be the race that decides whether Democrats maintain control of the Senate majority.
A recent New York Times poll has Trump leading Biden by 5 points in Michigan, which means keeping our state blue will not be easy – proving once again something all Michiganders know: Michigan is NOT a solid blue state, and as a swing state, we have a tendency to swing. But it is possible to hold the line and keep Michigan blue as long as we all stand together in this race.
And finally, Elissa doesn’t take money from corporate PACs. So while the four serious Republicans in this race are relying on dark money and/or their own personal fortunes, she is instead counting on lots and lots of people to chip in to build a winning campaign.
All of this is important because the money we raise and the decisions we make right now are going to have a huge impact on this race down the road. Because it's the early donations that allow our campaign to spend our resources as efficiently as possible. For instance, with money in the bank, we can buy TV and digital ad time early, before rates jack up in the fall.

I’ve been traveling the state connecting with Californians from all walks of life. From visiting with street vendors in LA, to talking with farm workers in the Central Valley, to meet and greets in San Francisco and Santa Cruz. I LOVE campaigning and hearing from Californians, and grassroots support has made all of these events possible. We’ve also been able to run digital ads , which are an effective and efficient way to reach the millions of undecided California voters who will decide this race. But now, things are about to really heat up. We’re filming our first TV ad soon, and finalizing our digital and TV ad buys. Buying ad time in California is not cheap, in fact it’s 13x more expensive in parts of California than in other parts of the country. I’m doing my best to stretch every dollar further, but polling shows us a third of voters are undecided about who they’ll support. | Hi, it’s Jane Fonda.

As we bid farewell to 2023, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your support and dedication to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Your unwavering commitment to combating the climate crisis propelled our journey through a year of challenges and triumphs. In our second election cycle, we’ve grown our team and the power of our grassroots movement. Before we head into 2024, I wanted to share some reflections and key takeaways from this year with you.

I know that we could not have achieved everything we did this year without the generosity of our grassroots supporters. subject: sharing a photo of my mom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
her bravery, her support, and her unyielding hope
| | |
---
Friend, when I look at this photo of my mom, I think about how much she sacrificed to give my family our American dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75252574/444087327/-1832279535?amounts=5,25,50,100&refcode=jtk327-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmRhYjExYWUtOTQ5Yi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kYXF-23E96i9DFaxaEriWLRJ8dqv_FP6FCQP_cObYcE=)
**When I was 14, my mom made the courageous decision to leave our home in Ecuador and bring my sisters and me to America.** She wanted so badly to give us an incredible education, access to affordable, high-quality health care, and a better life. And she was willing to do anything to make that happen.
When we first arrived in America, my family lived in a small one room apartment. My mom worked hard to pay the bills in those early days, working double shifts as a home health aide, taking English classes at night, and still making time to be an incredible, supportive mom.
I eventually started working at a local doughnut shop in the mornings before school began to help make ends meet. But she never once let our financial difficulties get in the way of my education. She brought us to America to get a chance at a better future, and that started with a strong education.
Because of my mom's sacrifices, her bravery, her support, and her unyielding hope, I was able to graduate high school and college, find a career giving back to my community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Today, I'm my mom's primary caretaker, and I'm so grateful that I can live with her and give her the care and comfort she deserves after doing so much for my family.
**But there are so many other moms out there who are still struggling to pay the bills, give their kids a shot at a better life, and win their American dream. And every day, that dream is looking further and further out of reach.**

**That's why I'm running for Senate: to give those families the leg up they need.** I'll fight tirelessly to make housing more affordable, increase access to high-quality health care, give more kids the chance to get a college degree, and so much more.
**[Please, if you believe that every family deserves a fair chance at winning their American dream, will you make a donation now to help me flip this seat blue and fight for working families in the Senate? I'll fight tirelessly to make housing more affordable, increase access to high-quality health care, give more kids the chance to get a college degree, and so much more. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

name: Jacob Carrel
subject: A new threat to fair maps out of Texas
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
We’re keeping a close eye on this →
|
---

Team,
We’re always keeping an eye out for new threats to the Voting Rights Act -- and there is another one snaking its way through the system. Another one just popped up.
While affirming a challenge to biased maps in Galveston, Texas, a panel from the 5th Circuit Court of Appeals called for the entire court to reconsider and potentially overturn precedent that helps ensure districts can be created where minority communities can together elect their candidates of choice. And now the full court, which has recently issued several conservative opinions, will take the case, signaling it may reverse itself on this critical issue.
Fights like these are essential to ensuring fair and equal representation for Black and Latino voters in the elections that determine their future.
With a critical election year just around the corner, All On The Line is keeping our finger on the pulse of threats to voting rights anywhere -- **we will organize wherever needed so voters can make their voices heard.[We want to know if you’re ready to fight alongside us: When the time comes to take action for fair maps in 2024 and beyond, can we count on you to join in?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75253151/444089383/314361794?source=20231213_AOTL_C_NewThreat_RedLite&refcode=20231213_AOTL_C_NewThreat_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBkOTk0YjVlLTk1OWItZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oA1YeD9rH2eJlaJx7n_U9WDtJYOrTvyZFh21hDfcNrA=&emci=a19a0851-e899-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=0d994b5e-959b-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=8431045)**

[**This is hardly the first time Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act has landed on the chopping block.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75253154/444089387/314361794?source=20231213_AOTL_C_NewThreat_RedLite&refcode=20231213_AOTL_C_NewThreat_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBkOTk0YjVlLTk1OWItZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oA1YeD9rH2eJlaJx7n_U9WDtJYOrTvyZFh21hDfcNrA=&emci=a19a0851-e899-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=0d994b5e-959b-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=8431045)
Just weeks ago, another court ruled that only the U.S. government -- not individuals or public-interest groups -- could sue to enforce Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act. That would shift most of the authority to whoever’s in the White House and make it harder to hold lawmakers accountable for trying to silence voters’ voices.
We’ll keep doing everything we can to ensure fairness and justice in our democracy -- but we can’t do it alone. **As we gear up to address the many challenges ahead, we need to know we have the full force of this dedicated community behind us.**

| The only way we are going to move forward as a country is by unifying around our shared values.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4758%2E5257348%2EFe1_t5)
Derek —
Kevin McCarthy, the former Speaker of the House and one of my main antagonists in the Congress, announced that he is resigning at the end of the year.
After fifteen humiliating votes to scrape and claw his way to the Speaker’s gavel, McCarthy immediately used his political capital to attack me — removing me from the Intelligence Committee. Vowing to the California Republican Party convention that I could “never” become California’s senator. Leading my censure under the personal threat of Donald Trump.
**But I’m still standing, and he's the one who lost the faith of his caucus and is now leaving Congress.**
I could go on for a _long_ time about why McCarthy’s departure from the House is no loss to the state or country.
But here’s what I’m thinking about today:
**McCarthy is all too symbolic of a Republican leadership that has no real ideology except the pursuit of power and will tie itself into knots trying to please Donald Trump in order to acquire power and hold onto it.**
The MAGA movement is now willing to eviscerate the civil service, mobilize the military domestically, weaponize the Justice Department to go after political opponents, and terminate the Constitution if they lose the next election. These are all positions their party leader has articulated, and they are still devoted to him.
**The only way we are going to move forward as a country is by defeating this anti-democratic cult of personality and fighting for our democracy and an economy that works for everyone.**
And Derek, with less than 12 weeks until our primary, we need to engage right now, as the MAGA crowd tries to stop me from reaching the Senate.
McCarthy will have a lot of time — and money — to meddle in our race in the homestretch to fulfill his promise that I can never be California's senator. We cannot — and will not — let his brand of politics win.

Friend,

The GOP’s plan to overturn _Roe_ was a culmination of the far right’s decades long attack on reproductive freedom – but it was not the end of their efforts.

Since the U.S. Supreme Court’s calamitous decision last year, Republicans across the country and at every level of office have used their power to legislate over women’s bodies: abortion bans in dozens of states, attempts to ban contraception, and even an attempt to ban abortion medication _everywhere_ in the country.
We’re seeing the dangerous consequences play out in real time. In Texas, a judge granted a mother of two experiencing a fatal genetic complication in her third pregnancy a medical exception to seek an abortion – only for extremist Republican state attorney general, Ken Paxton, to intervene and ask the state Supreme Court to block that exception despite the fact that the developing fetus had no hope of survival. Paxton also threatened the doctor and hospitals with criminal charges should they provide the medically necessary care. The mother's health was at risk, as was her future fertility. To protect her health, she had to flee the state of Texas to seek the care Republicans there denied her – a course of action not possible for all in her situation.

Elsewhere, the U.S. Supreme Court has decided to hear a challenge to medical abortion pill access. While there are some favorable signs that the Court could overturn the Fifth Circuit’s ruling – a ruling that would seriously curb the distribution of certain abortion medication if allowed to take effect – the fact that American women must even consider the possibility of this treatment being banned is an outrage.
Here’s what this all boils down to: The Republican Party is using any and all means they have at their disposal to restrict a woman’s bodily autonomy completely. As Texas proved, legislation that purports to provide an “exception” for health of the mother cannot be trusted – their “exception” clauses are window dressing, if you will, designed to hide what their law really is: _a ban._

Legal limbo, uncertainty, elected politicians and judges dictating healthcare decisions instead of doctors – what kind of country are we living in? Contact: Duane Dichiara

| **Stanislaus County Supervisor Vito Chiesa Endorses Congressman John Duarte **** **
---
| | **Modesto, CA – **Today, Congressman John Duarte (R-CA13) reports an endorsement from Stanislaus Supervisor Vito Chiesa. Supervisor Chiesa assumed office in 2009 and is serving his fourth term. Chiesa is a Valley farmer, owning and operating a family walnut and almond farm. Supervisor Chiesa has also been a community leader for years, serving as the State Director for the California Farm Bureau, Director for the Modesto Chamber of Commerce, and President of the California State Association of Counties.

“I am proud to endorse John Duarte and his re-election campaign to Congress,” said Vito Chiesa. “John isn’t afraid to stand up for the Central Valley in Washington. He has a record of putting farmers, working families, and our Valley values first. That’s what we need in the Central Valley: leaders focused on delivering results, not partisan politics.”

John Duarte’s campaign is proud to report the growing local support from leaders across the community backing his campaign. Supervisor Chiesa’s endorsement underscores why local leaders, businesses, and organizations continue to support his campaign. John is determined to work in a bipartisan fashion to lift up and serve Valley families. For more information about John Duarte or the campaign, please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=9992680a3b&e=76a47b375f).

| | Hello! We hope you’re doing well. It was another busy week for Team Alsobrooks connecting with Marylanders and ringing in the holiday season. Angela was on the road meeting with people across our state, hearing directly from them about the future they want to see in Maryland. It’s beginning to look a lot like the holiday season in Maryland and Angela had a great time ringing in the season at the Annapolis Links Holiday Gala. Organizations like the Links do so much for the community, and it was an honor to join them for their holiday celebration. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=7&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4) On Tuesday, Angela met with business leaders in Baltimore County to discuss what can be done to better support small-business owners in Maryland. It was a great opportunity to hear how she can better serve the community. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=8&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4) This Thursday, Angela was overjoyed to attend a community event with Senator Chris Van Hollen. She had a great time chatting with Marylanders in Rockville about all things Maryland. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=9&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4) **NEWS OF THE WEEK** **[TJ Smith With Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8812?t=10&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4)** _Alsobrooks could shatter the Senate glass ceiling for Black women and make Maryland the new nexus of Black political muscle_ **[Employ Prince George's Opens Doors to New Building Trades Career Center](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8813?t=11&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4)** _"We are thrilled to open this new center that will make Prince George's County a national leader in workforce development for construction trades," said Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks expressing her enthusiasm. "From our young people in career and technical education programs to returning citizens and veterans, we are committed to providing opportunities for all our residents to obtain good-paying jobs."_ Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line next November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=12&akid=759%2E52803%2EmnRkV4)

The victories we’ve shared over the last several years have come because people like you have stepped up to the plate and chipped in some of your hard-earned money.

Peter,**** RFK Jr is **polling at 26% in Arizona and Michigan and 24% overall in a three-way race.** We’ve also engaged more first time supporters than any campaign before — guess people **really are fed up!**

To continue our momentum, we’re looking to activate as many new supporters by the end of the year as possible. With our updated profile pages, you can now recruit donors and supporters through your own unique ID. **[Just create a profile,](https://www.kennedy24.com/brigidrasmussen?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=recruit_and_support_5&n=2) add a little bit about you, and start sending your links!** On the page you will also find a variety of graphics and QR codes to use at your [grassroots events](https://www.kennedy24.com/grassroots-events?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=recruit_and_support_5&n=3), when you're canvassing, or when you just meet a potential supporter at the grocery store.
