## Congress Passes Record Defense Bill
The House and Senate approved a record-high [$886 billion defense policy bill](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMms92GpMo6sbOzeEVRCgEjXhFRKOfWPykZOmNIjKVK0O3NlkVx7XEmLd7YqITmNhWM7XB_GyZwX7E_yQLWhgs1nMPrNBPJfBR1R-4AbgKoLQlJZsFYGg_CSS_naYQ5Dq-MOGm1xK0bH8nBu3-xPTlr37LUpEVdwqeGZjukK62IyfwzFIHc5pF-38zAvnl6v3Vc1ZCgsjuH7wjEYQ0hcPARZp6JPPfO7tmSMSQMvK8zCw-lkAAhE2Q32ICbzYa_t4AZ2dlgejwU2TTuXAkDTpvnOhHxtMok4nS0PXt8MnslX2), up 3% from last year. It includes a 5.2% pay raise for troops, the biggest pay boost in decades. The bill passed in the Senate 87-13 and the House 310-118, despite concerns from some GOP members that the bill keeps intact Pentagon "social-engineering" policies, such as abortion access. Rep. Mike Rogers, chairman of the House Armed Services Committee, said he was "disappointed" the House didn't get all it wanted but that the bill was ["a good compromise."](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMo6iqEPnqN710UHnGGdwFhjvf8PMCGmHP6bajqnWsVibXfBWROMqZQr0mh1sH8uRYEaMPEblM1hMxrFwkktLtzb_q4Pozq0wDBSv9hW3mYvqRyTlgtcMQuGu67Vwyhabk7YeNWUtVwH8X2OTK16G-556eCxW1ba14elYICJGhtK1OoOAD1SzkvkDcVzWPXvEw17xORKcXe61Dyv95dDljO6QS0KQheMabA1_K7WmPwXh66KnxsZAcpRkwexfflsu5w%3D%3D)
## Wisconsin Trades Diversity for Cash
The Wisconsin Board of Regents reversed itself and [approved a state GOP deal](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMq6fI4Y-dXm18pfvwbOr2KMN_hBNPYlgHUI48cFst4xQy9DpWthJnLv2Xtyda4AS0o7JACZpDldFb1NjLAGsqPfFFnncmMAnEI5snB0yU9vqwFZifTx66pUt21DxEhAeJTTEMBwH5sEWvZrMVT7YmmIM3uhRp1Hh8F3BMlBvcuLxjq6JmGLSV7S1axrv2NhewdTwTT4-Tx61-jH3ABKieQLPwaeDv6bmhcR1RVtb18rzhgE6cmtjR-zLdYB78W0JR9Br0FequJVNW775ReAnsmyb-PgdaGA12AjSaX8Khr9z) for $800 million in university funding in exchange for freezing new hires of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) officers. Additionally, 43 existing DEI jobs will be reclassified to new positions, and campuses will have to eliminate statements supporting "diversity" on student applications. The state legislature refused to approve the $800 million budget increase for pay raises and capitol improvements without the DEI deal. The Board of Regents initially turned it down but [reversed the decision](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMkNvm0-HCUP1N0bZv9_SIi2hEpxb0ZHAM2oUykY_VfouP-fcMGTsKxXDV14UYHtVA-0Ic-CD2i4CRegS-KrSsepiLZ22Smf-61ssjmmQV_aSYFhtLt3YAuyxcrPMhQBVvRpMkmoXfPjPTO182HKDADCWK-Byqwwnl74Vtl5yFTdZt_yv3c12lwrM3y-ZlLQihDHcP_nse3OgyhqBvFMTOMkR65DAOqYJFyGwjVqC1pT-IYKlu61eiXk06oXno6ns3AYw9CSFfhKSv4wjF2fLg7u3_IFRQkHjkQa6AeEiSpJmLdLoO1dS7hyrLCLuO7rKvii5lrspXKMEdcf0KBCVslM%3D) in a surprise vote Wednesday.
## Mickey Mouse Losing Copyright Protection
After 95 years, the original version of Mickey Mouse is finally losing copyright protection and [entering the public domain](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMlDEFp9wzExuL3NFCSFSaYZMakz-0qkgBjyvZxdLiMtKuc85D-4R_KNopVjkliMkEr71mbOsDFoGJVVLJArj0TyVjKtY8NIxPtGzCJGE3WoZIIJppeA2q__C7kQ5g7w-Dl7xsPDYLwnH77X_KdAKbuhb-eF-oVp1Y2u8m4FZGAe6eUUqlwAsMIzhJldefGwjZSPPr2uVr2nG2pisJlM28km0sJgA3fUOY6h1ia4RMpQSe3Q_WstLArrlsGf4DMXzOt6zyT2vq-AxHH4owme948whzRzNRYiabcqCe1A8wEra), where anyone can use the character as long as it doesn't appear to come from Disney. Mickey's first appearance was in the primitive 1928 cartoon ["Steamboat Willie,"](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMtFlA6Iycu4DQQTtKvuJ7mmF_CN-wWNs42yVeC5opSdjHFAIhwc190sBb8vuVi2tNaUI7ym8arCOYtZWrYWxZtUeVGMGrTNqNbZyoztZTI69a3BjAR4-xalpATcyr9qUOQadwCPD1sZd_47JURv-J2O85M1EWet96_pCUNYvFbMaMnaxCrF1Pd6Wy9sE0XHylxvZienK1ZY7dDa-aCYYE2k%3D) and that's the only version that's entering the public domain -- the sweet, hapless Mickey from the 1930s on is still protected. Another character that recently entered the public domain is Winnie the Pooh. He and Piglet were immediately reimagined as bloodthirsty villains in the slasher film ["Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey."](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=b45e83064f92472d9a63781e2ffbbc49&_e=h-INRRZTtdMXKFIsHsrGMt9qJ0W0cSbz97YwOXtlrwz8Vl9r3vsUgzVmbgtDozsPg4uMNU8oM0s645ijPPHzu9MaN7eKzZL6rDvpkszPS98d0-cSqC4502ZDR3_U6CSQVhTrbPDkF_HZCYGP142gN1K1bNN8gCe1Fyq4ZKyb7iOcu8ccUDmYkDfkLehx18tSKQhRfjqtQXetqGgJX4MKA63areEQvHX1pMwgfwgOkX1YvXyI3mre1013Zv9VVHza)

Ryan Mackenzie For U.S. Congress | | | | | [](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=ef801a0b7f&e=5ccada9200)

# _THE MACKENZIE MINUTE_
|
---

Friend,
My campaign continued to build momentum this week when we picked up another big endorsement, and I continued to travel the district meeting with voters and local leaders. Here are some highlights from this week:
• Associated Builders and Contractors Eastern Pennsylvania Chapter Endorsement• Pennsylvania Integrity Network Meeting• Northwestern Lehigh Christmas Tree Lighting • Northern Lehigh Candy Cane Hunt in Slatington • Voter Meeting in Center Valley
As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,
|
---
**NEWS**
|
---
**Associated Builders and Contractors Eastern Pennsylvania Endorsement**
This week, I received the endorsement of the Associated Builders and Contractors (ABC) Eastern Pennsylvania Chapter. They represent more than seventeen thousand merit construction employees who work for its almost six hundred-member companies in seventeen eastern Pennsylvania counties.
ABC Eastern Pennsylvania Chapter said they are proud to endorse Ryan Mackenzie for United States Congress (PA-7). “ Ryan has worked tirelessly for his constituents as a member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives and we know he will do the same in Washington D.C.”, said Joe Perpiglia, President & CEO of Associated Builders and Contractors Eastern Pennsylvania Chapter, adding “he is stalwart for labor and always operates in the best interest of everyone in our industry”.

|
---
**Pennsylvania Integrity Network Meeting**
I joined the Pennsylvania Integrity Network on Wednesday, to discuss concerns over PA’s voting systems, and improvements that can be made to ensure accuracy and trust in elections. I also explained the Mackenzie Election Integrity Team’s efforts in the recent election.
|
---
**Northwestern Christmas Tree Lighting**
I enjoyed joining many residents in Northwestern Lehigh for their annual Christmas Tree lighting ceremony as part of the kick-off of the Christmas season.
|
---
**Northern Lehigh Candy Cane Hunt in Slatington**
Saturday morning I stopped by the Northern Lehigh Candy Cane Hunt held in Slatington. The Candy Cane Hunt is one of the great community events around the 7th District that celebrates the joy of the Christmas season.
|
---
**Voter Meeting in Center Valley**
As part of my on-going efforts to meet voters across the 7th District and talk about issues, it was nice to speak with a group of concerned parents and activists about what is happening in our schools, the efforts I have made to address these issues as a State Representative, and why I am the right choice to continue these efforts in Congress.
|
---
If you would like to be part of our team, please reach out at [info@mackenzieforcongress.com](mailto:info@mackenzieforcongress.com) or call my campaign at (484) 347-8777.

body:
A loss here would enable Republicans to pass a national abortion ban.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1855%2E4032634%2EjQXbA6)
---
Wisconsin has a well-earned reputation for razor-thin races — and next year’s U.S. Senate election doesn’t look like it will be an exception. My friend and colleague Tammy Baldwin is up for re-election. She’s one of the toughest fighters working families could ask for. And that’s exactly why powerful interests and right-wing extremists are trying so hard to knock her out of the game. This month, the NRSC just confirmed that GOP megamillionaire — Eric Hovde — will run against her to flip Wisconsin red. **I’ll just be blunt: if Democrats lose this race, it’s going to be nearly impossible to hold onto our Senate majority. You know what that means: either a GOP Senate that’s all-obstruction-all-the-time against President Biden, or a GOP Senate that’s greasing the skids for Donald Trump if he’s back in the White House.** [**So can you please split a donation of $28 or any amount between Tammy Baldwin and me to help hold the Senate and fight for the bold reforms we need? The GOP and the NRSC will look at fundraising performance from this quarter to determine how competitive this race will be, and your contribution will help demonstrate Democrats’ strength.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1026?amount=28&t=8&akid=1855%2E4032634%2EjQXbA6)

Listen, Eric Hovde is an anti-abortion extremist who supports a national abortion ban. He is “totally opposed to abortion” and committed to passing his anti-abortion agenda at the federal level. His win would enable Republicans to pass a national abortion ban. Last year in Wisconsin, Republicans spent a record $77 million to defend Ron Johnson, and they won that Senate race by just 1%. The GOP is poised to throw everything they have into defeating Tammy next year, and we can expect it will come down to the wire. So every day, every dollar, and every vote counts in this race. Tammy Baldwin has been able to count on this team for support — and we can always count on her to fight for our values. From lowering the cost of prescription drugs, to promoting Made in America manufacturing, to making marriage equality the law of the land no matter what the Supreme Court has to say about it, Tammy Baldwin takes on tough fights and gets results. We need to keep her voice in Washington, where she fights and wins for working families and works to protect our freedoms, including the right to an abortion. If it makes sense for you right now, please split a contribution of $28 or anything you can between Tammy Baldwin and our re-election campaign. name: Laurel Imer
subject: Greetings from Turning Point USA's America Fest!
disclaimer_text: Paid for By Laurel Imer and is not approved by any candidate or candidates committee
body:
I am in Phoenix, AZ this weekend as a guest of Turning Point Action at America Fest with over 15,000 Gen Z and Conservative activists. Learn more by opening this email...
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m3u17TOnGonJL31QNmSVZzWezH1B7bLmu7XaPUY3E3jEvcEO83xsAXmcJsUuXTzr7WsuTmWeHzpoYNe-yZuc7Dz7unzaF7KfvMLVhOPJexTFFtHA_wwhnsA9_murrFw2QMPp9XlxCBH15WFhRY1NuBwwU-lkkfM2&c=33EQHfBgQpnf-T625usybw2db9gfYYRU4XPswr0UbCB38T0xdkUNyA==&ch=NaCD7FgVs-bEUNJ0oKkBDxL1FGs7iFrcC8SeQpBrjkKUeu9ZZPY8zw==)
---
---
| Patriot,
This weekend, I am attending Turning Point USA's America Fest in Phoenix, AZ!
Turning Point Action, an arm of TPUSA invited me to attend and participate in the conference in order to network with Gen Z, meet with current members of the Republican National Committee, and grow the message of our campaign for National Committeewoman.
Part of the messaging around this event is to be a conservative rebel, and there is a difference between being a rebel and simply causing a ruckus.
We need a well connected, grass roots leader that has an understanding of national political activism, that is prepared to put in the hard work of reaching the next generation of voters, and is willing to sacrifice their time to the endeavor, not just writing a mega donor check to a candidate and buying their way to the top.
As your next Republican National Committeewoman, I pledge to put in the hard work, be reachable, be supportive of our candidates, and engage in the outreach that our party so desperately needs to do.
I will be a rebel for the America First Grassroots movement! I won't just make a bunch of noise and talk tough. This is not about attending party functions where I can look important, it is about being with you, the people of the Republican Party.
At the end of the day, we are all working for the same goals and I want to be a part of those victories with you!

name: Katie Porter
subject: Require airlines to refund for preventable delays or cancellations
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34836%2E3422442%2E3pPeTX)
While flying from DC to LAX yesterday, I was thinking about last year’s flightmare, when Southwest Airlines canceled more than 17,000 flights.
The cancellations left passengers stranded, without refund or rebooking options. **This meltdown, and the airline industry as a whole, is a great example of why we need both market competition and effective government oversight.**
As airlines have merged and acquired one another, passengers pay more and get subpar service and workers end up with worse pay and benefit options. I’ve expressed much concern about the proposed Frontier and Spirit Airlines merger for this exact reason.
I’ve also introduced legislation to fix it. My **Choices for Stranded Passengers Act** would require refunds or prompt rebookings in cases of preventable delays or cancellations, even if the airline must purchase a ticket on another carrier. I’ve also introduced bills to stop airplane seat shrinkage and prevent airlines like Southwest from cutting corners by using antiquated scheduling technology.
[**So if you’re traveling this holiday season, consider signing my petition to show your support for these bills to better regulate the airlines.**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-stranded-passengers-act/?source=EMAO23_2_SPA_20231215_V1_F&akid=34836%2E3422442%2E3pPeTX)
[Add your name >>](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-stranded-passengers-act/?source=EMAO23_2_SPA_20231215_V1_F&akid=34836%2E3422442%2E3pPeTX)
Happy travels, and Happy Holidays!
Katie Porter
